title: Persona Guardrail: A Production-Grade Defense Framework for Agentic Systems
abstract: Large language model-based agents are increasingly deployed to perform domain-specific tasks by interacting with enterprise knowledge, tools, and external services. Existing runtime guardrails primarily target prompt injection and other attack-specific behaviors under a black-box threat model, but provide limited guarantees that agents operate within their intended functionality. As a result, production agents remain vulnerable to malicious requests and out-of-domain queries that existing defenses often fail to distinguish. We present Persona Guardrail, a production-grade runtime defense framework that enforces explicit functional boundaries for customer-facing agentic AI systems through synchronous input and output validation driven by semantic allowlist and blocklist specifications. We also introduce PAGE (Persona-Aware Guardrail Evaluation), a benchmark for evaluating function-specific guardrails across benign, adversarial, and out-of-domain interactions on both user and agent turns. Compared with a generic LLM-based guardrail, Persona Guardrail improves overall accuracy from 85.7% to 95.9%, increases out-of-domain detection from 57.3% to 93.5%, and reduces the false-approved rate from 25.0% to 4.7%. Currently deployed in production, Persona Guardrail meets its latency budget while sustaining a very low false-block and false-allow rate under realistic production workloads. These results demonstrate that Persona Guardrail provides a practical, scalable, and production-ready foundation for securing agentic AI systems.
title_cn: Persona Guardrail：面向智能体系统的生产级防御框架
abstract_cn: 基于大语言模型的智能体日益被部署执行领域任务，与企业知识、工具和外部服务交互。现有运行时护栏主要针对提示注入等攻击特定行为、采用黑盒威胁模型，但对智能体在其预期功能内运行的保证有限。因此生产智能体对恶意请求与域外查询仍然脆弱，而现有防御往往无法区分两者。我们提出 Persona Guardrail，一个生产级运行时防御框架：由语义白名单与黑名单规范驱动的同步输入输出验证，为面向客户的智能体 AI 系统强制显式功能边界。我们还提出 PAGE（Persona 感知护栏评估）基准，在用户与智能体两侧轮次上、跨良性、对抗与域外交互评估功能特定护栏。与通用 LLM 护栏相比，Persona Guardrail 把总体准确率从 85.7% 提到 95.9%，域外检测从 57.3% 提到 93.5%，误批准率从 25.0% 降到 4.7%。Persona Guardrail 已在生产部署，在满足延迟预算的同时，在现实生产负载下保持极低的误拦与误放行率。结果表明 Persona Guardrail 是保护智能体 AI 系统的实用、可扩展且生产就绪的基础。
summary_cn: 生产部署的功能边界护栏 Persona Guardrail 与 PAGE 基准：对通用 LLM 护栏总体准确率 85.7%→95.9%、域外检测 57.3%→93.5%、误批准 25.0%→4.7%，且满足生产延迟预算。
objective_summary: 提出以语义白/黑名单规范驱动输入输出验证的生产级护栏框架，强制智能体功能边界，并构建跨良性、对抗与域外交互的 PAGE 基准与通用 LLM 护栏对比。
evidence_note: 已在生产环境部署并报告延迟预算达成与生产负载下的误拦/误放行率；PAGE 基准上与通用 LLM 护栏对照给出三组量化提升（85.7→95.9、57.3→93.5、25.0→4.7）。
novelty_note: 语义白/黑名单护栏与允许功能边界的思想在护栏文献中已有，新意主要在生产化工程与 PAGE 基准；与攻击特定防御的区分是定位性贡献。
scope: 结论适用于面向客户、有明确功能边界定义的智能体系统与 PAGE 所测交互类型；对无清晰 persona 定义的场景与多语言输入未覆盖。
limitations: 规范需人工编写并随功能演进而维护；对比基线仅通用 LLM 护栏一类；PAGE 为自建基准，跨框架泛化未验证。

title: Defense-in-Depth at the Perception-Reasoning Interface of LLM-Centric Agentic UAV Swarms
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly support Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle (UAV) swarm operations such as data collection scheduling, where the model reads structured sensor reports and decides which sensors to visit. An adversary who quietly manipulates those reports can redirect the swarm without modifying the model weights or the UAV. Defenses for this interface have been proposed architecturally but rarely implemented or evaluated. We implement and evaluate defense-in-depth at the perception-reasoning interface of LLM-Centric Agentic UAV Swarms. Five layers check the provenance of a report, whether its values are physically admissible, whether they agree with what swarm geometry and service history predict, whether the resulting schedule starves any sensor, and, when these fail, hand control to a deterministic scheduler that ignores the suspect input. We test each layer against an adversary strong enough to defeat the layer before it. For each of the three input-side layers, we derive in closed form how far a report can be distorted before that layer reacts, fixing each boundary from deployment parameters before any attack data is collected; across thirty matched simulation runs, predicted and measured boundaries agree. Separating attack detection from response is a well-established principle, and we quantify the cost of neglecting this distinction at the perception-reasoning interface. When the system rejects a report, it replaces it with the most recent accepted report. This prevents the adversary from controlling the UAV schedule, but it also increases cumulative cost by 79% and 74% for the two detectors, respectively, compared with the undefended system. The safety check does not detect any attacks, but it nevertheless reduces the attack-induced cost by 37.5%.
comment: 14 Pages, 7 Tables, 4 Figures
title_cn: LLM 中心智能体无人机集群感知-推理界面的纵深防御
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）日益支持无人机（UAV）集群操作，如数据采集调度：模型读取结构化传感器报告并决定访问哪些传感器。悄然篡改这些报告的攻击者可以在不修改模型权重或无人机的情况下改变集群走向。这一界面的防御已有架构性提案，但很少被实现或评估。我们实现并评估 LLM 中心智能体无人机集群感知-推理界面的纵深防御。五层分别检查报告的来源、其数值是否物理可容许、是否与集群几何和服务历史的预测一致、所得调度是否让任何传感器被饿死，以及在这些检查失败时把控制权交给忽略可疑输入的确定性调度器。我们用足以击败前一层的攻击者逐层测试。对三个输入侧层，我们以闭式形式推导报告在被该层响应前可被扭曲的距离，并在收集任何攻击数据前从部署参数固定每个边界；三十次匹配仿真运行中预测与测量边界一致。把攻击检测与响应分离是公认原则，我们量化了在感知-推理界面忽视这一区分的代价：系统拒绝报告时用最近被接受的报告替代，这防止攻击者控制 UAV 调度，但使两个检测器的累计成本分别增加 79% 与 74%。安全检查未检测到任何攻击，但仍把攻击诱导成本降低 37.5%。
summary_cn: 实现并评估无人机集群 LLM 调度界面的五层纵深防御：闭式推导扭曲边界且 30 次仿真中预测吻合；拒绝替代策略防控制但累计成本 +79%/+74%，安全检查单独仍降攻击成本 37.5%。
objective_summary: 为 LLM 无人机集群的感知-推理界面实现五层防御（来源、物理容许、几何/历史一致性、饿死检查、确定性回退），闭式推导各层响应边界并在仿真中逐层以更强攻击者验证。
evidence_note: 三十次匹配仿真运行、闭式边界与实测一致、逐层升级攻击者的对照设计并量化成本开销（+79%/74%、-37.5%）；全部为仿真评估，无实物飞行实验。
novelty_note: 防御组件（来源校验、物理约束、一致性检查）为已知技术，新意在首个针对该界面的实现化评估与边界闭式化，以及对检测/响应分离代价的量化。
scope: 结论适用于数据采集调度类集群任务与仿真环境；对其他任务类型、通信层攻击与真实飞行硬件未覆盖。
limitations: 拒绝报告的替代策略大幅增加累计成本（+79%/74%）；安全检查对攻击无检测能力仅有间接缓解；仿真环境与真实传感噪声存在差距。

title: Asymptotic Analysis of Trading Fees in CFMM
abstract: As the dominant trading mechanism in decentralized finance, Automated Market Maker has been widely studied in research. However, limited research has been done with the trading fees taken into consideration. In this work, we study how much trading fee Liquidity Providers(LPs) can receive from arbitrage trading when the fee rate approaches zero. We give a closed-form formula for it and our result shows that the trading fees generated by arbitrage trading can fully offset the LVR loss when the price process is continuous. We further extend our conclusions to price processes with jumps and the theoretical analysis shows that jumps are the only cause of LP loss apart from market risks. Our results provide practical guidance for AMM designers as well as LPs.
title_cn: CFMM 交易手续费的渐近分析
abstract_cn: 作为去中心化金融中的主导交易机制，自动做市商（AMM）已被广泛研究，但把交易手续费纳入考虑的研究有限。我们研究当费率趋近于零时，流动性提供者（LP）能从套利交易中获得多少手续费。我们给出其闭式公式，结果表明当价格过程连续时，套利交易产生的手续费可以完全抵消 LVR 损失。我们进一步把结论扩展到带跳的价格过程，理论分析表明跳是除市场风险外 LP 损失的唯一原因。结果为 AMM 设计者与 LP 提供实用指导。
summary_cn: 给出费率趋零时 LP 套利手续费的闭式公式：价格过程连续时手续费可完全抵消 LVR 损失；扩展到带跳过程，证明跳是市场风险外 LP 损失的唯一原因。
objective_summary: 对恒函数做市商（CFMM）在费率趋零极限下的 LP 套利手续费收入推导闭式公式，并分析连续价格与带跳价格下手续费与 LVR 损失的关系。
evidence_note: 闭式公式与带跳扩展的完整理论推导；属金融数学建模，无实证数据校准（摘要未提实验）。
novelty_note: LVR 与 AMM 套利理论已有成熟文献（LVR 框架），本文把手续费纳入该框架并给出零费极限闭式，属增量理论改进。
scope: 结论适用于 CFMM 类 AMM 与费率趋零渐近区；对动态费率、集中流动性区间订单与 MEV 策略博弈未覆盖。
limitations: 渐近结果在有限费率下的适用性未量化；假设套利者竞争性定价；未用真实交易数据验证。

title: Reversing the Clock: Layout-Aware Recovery of Design Intent from Clock Distribution Networks
abstract: Hardware reverse engineering supports competitive analysis and hardware assurance by recovering information about an integrated circuit (IC) from its physical implementation. While existing techniques primarily recover the gate-level netlist, which represents logical functionality, they often overlook physical design decisions such as placement, routing, delay insertion, and interconnect optimization. The clock distribution network encapsulates many of these decisions; however, no prior published work has recovered this network from a fabricated IC to infer design intent. We present a layout-aware methodology that recovers and analyzes the clock distribution network by integrating a recovered gate-level netlist with layout information extracted from scanning electron microscope imagery. Our four-phase pipeline recovers clock-tree topology, buffering, gating and switching, interconnect delay, and crosstalk-mitigation measures. We demonstrate our methodology on a commercial 450 nm IC, recovering a global H-tree backbone with local X-tree-like branching, identifying an independent clock tree and global clock gating, quantifying latency, skew, and routing lengths, and confirming the absence of dedicated crosstalk mitigation. Together, these findings let us reason about the designer's intent. To encourage further research and support reproducibility, we release our clock tree recovery algorithm as open source.
comment: Accepted at the IEEE International Conference on Physical Assurance and Inspection of Electronics (PAINE) 2026
title_cn: 逆转时钟：从时钟分布网络恢复设计意图的版图感知方法
abstract_cn: 硬件逆向工程通过从集成电路（IC）物理实现中恢复信息，支持竞争分析与硬件保障。现有技术主要恢复门级网表（表示逻辑功能），往往忽视布局、布线、延迟插入与互连优化等物理设计决策。时钟分布网络封装了其中许多决策；然而此前没有已发表工作从制造完成的 IC 中恢复该网络以推断设计意图。我们提出版图感知方法：把恢复的门级网表与从扫描电镜图像提取的版图信息整合，恢复并分析时钟分布网络。四阶段流水线恢复时钟树拓扑、缓冲、门控与开关、互连延迟与串扰缓解措施。我们在一颗商用 450nm IC 上演示该方法：恢复出带局部 X 树状分支的全局 H 树主干，识别出独立时钟树与全局时钟门控，量化延迟、偏斜与布线长度，并确认缺少专用串扰缓解。这些发现使我们能够推断设计者的意图。为鼓励进一步研究并支持可复现，我们开源时钟树恢复算法。
summary_cn: 首个从制造 IC 恢复时钟分布网络的版图感知四阶段流水线：在商用 450nm 芯片上恢复 H 树主干、独立时钟树与全局门控并量化延迟/偏斜，用以推断设计意图；算法已开源。
objective_summary: 提出整合门级网表与 SEM 版图信息的四阶段时钟分布网络恢复流水线，在商用 450nm IC 上恢复拓扑、门控与时序参数，从物理设计决策推断设计意图。
evidence_note: 在单颗商用 450nm IC 上完整演示，多方面量化（拓扑、缓冲、门控、延迟、偏斜、布线长度）；单一芯片案例、PAINE 2026 录用，无多样本对比。
novelty_note: 作者指出此前无已发表工作从制造 IC 恢复时钟分布网络以推断设计意图，属该方向首个端到端演示，把逆向工程从网表层推进到物理设计意图层。
scope: 结论适用于成熟工艺（演示为 450nm）平面版图的时钟网络分析；对先进工艺、遮挡/多层金属与加密或混淆设计未验证。
limitations: 单芯片演示，方法对不同工艺节点与设计风格的泛化未知；SEM 成像与版图对齐成本高；恢复精度依赖图像质量与人工校验程度。

title: LiBRA: Detection-Aware Image Watermark Removal via Bidirectional Latent Optimization
abstract: Digital watermarking supports source attribution for AI-generated images, but its reliability depends on resistance to removal attacks. Some attacks attempt to remove watermarks by forcing the decoded watermark to differ from the original. However, this can produce an inverted watermark that remains detectable, causing removal to fail, while further attempts to alter the watermark may unnecessarily degrade image quality. To address these limitations, we present LiBRA (Latent In-band Bidirectional Removal Attack), which aims to make watermarks undetectable while preserving image quality. Instead of continually pushing the watermark toward inversion, LiBRA adjusts the image to conceal the watermark without encouraging further changes that could degrade image quality. Some attacks keep pushing decoded bits away from the original watermark, even when further changes preserve detectability and damage image quality. With access to the watermark key and decoder, LiBRA makes bounded changes in a public autoencoder's latent space. Unlike inversion-driven objectives that cannot correct excessive inversion, LiBRA guides average decoding confidence toward random guessing from either direction. This helps avoid an inverted but detectable watermark. Leaving individual bits flexible allows image-quality constraints to favor less damaging changes, while an optional frequency-guided mask limits their location. We verify removal using an exact two-sided binomial test rather than assuming the confidence target guarantees success.
title_cn: LiBRA：检测感知的图像水印移除（双向隐空间优化）
abstract_cn: 数字水印支撑 AI 生成图像的来源归因，但其可靠性取决于对移除攻击的抵抗力。一些攻击试图通过迫使解码水印偏离原水印来移除水印，但这可能产生仍可检测的反转水印，导致移除失败；而进一步改变水印的尝试可能不必要地损害图像质量。为解决这些局限，我们提出 LiBRA（潜空间带内双向移除攻击），目标是让水印不可检测同时保持图像质量。LiBRA 不再把水印持续推向反转，而是调整图像以隐藏水印，不鼓励可能损害质量的进一步改变。一些攻击即使继续改变仍保持可检测并损害质量，仍把解码比特推离原水印。在拥有水印密钥与解码器的条件下，LiBRA 在公开自编码器的隐空间中做有界改变。与无法纠正过度反转的反转驱动目标不同，LiBRA 把平均解码置信度从两个方向引导向随机猜测，有助于避免反转但可检测的水印。允许单个比特保持灵活，让图像质量约束偏向损害更小的改变，可选的频率引导掩码限制改变的位置。我们用精确的双侧二项检验验证移除，而非假设置信目标保证成功。
summary_cn: 提出把解码置信度双向引向随机猜测的水印移除攻击 LiBRA：避免「反转仍可检测」的失败模式，在隐空间做有界改动并保画质，以精确双侧二项检验验证移除效果。
objective_summary: 提出检测感知的水印移除攻击 LiBRA：在公开自编码器隐空间做有界双向优化，使解码置信趋向随机猜测而非持续反转，兼顾不可检测性与图像质量，并用双侧二项检验验证。
evidence_note: 以精确双侧二项检验作为移除判定标准并强调图像质量约束；摘要未列出具体被测水印方案、数据集与成功率数字，评估范围待正文确认。
novelty_note: 诊断出「反转仍可检测」的既有攻击失败模式并以双向随机化目标纠正，属对水印移除攻击线的实质性改进；假设持有关键与解码器（白盒）。
scope: 结论假设攻击者可获得水印密钥与解码器（白盒设定），适用于所测隐空间自编码器类水印；对黑盒水印与频域盲水印未覆盖。
limitations: 白盒密钥假设限制实际威胁范围；仅在隐空间自编码器框架内操作；摘要未报告跨水印方案的成功率与画质量化结果。

title: EvoRiskBench: An Evolving Benchmark for Runtime Security Risks in Workspace Agents
abstract: Workspace agents combine large language models with execution harnesses to perform stateful, multi-step tasks that access or modify external resources. Existing benchmarks leave gaps in executable coverage of their runtime security risks, while evolving model capabilities, harnesses, tools, and threats motivate benchmark evolution. We introduce EvoRiskBench, an evolving benchmark organized around the EP-Path-EF framework, which links an initial risk entry point to a one-hop technical effect through an agent-mediated risk path. The framework defines nine entry-point categories and five effect categories; a 20-participant study supports their interpretability and classification consistency on representative cases. Guided by this framework, an automated end-to-end workflow constructs and executes risk cases in isolated environments and independently verifies outcomes using runtime traces and environment states. The benchmark provides a reproducible dataset of 450 adversarial tasks across six scenarios. We evaluate nine model-harness configurations spanning three models (GPT-5.6 Sol, DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, and Claude Opus 5) and three harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw). Our results reveal substantial vulnerabilities across systems. The most vulnerable configuration, Codex with DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, reaches a 68.44% attack success rate (ASR), indicating that configuration of workspace agent is insufficient to ensure secure autonomous execution. ASR varies more across models than harnesses, and harness differences depend on the model. The benchmark cases and evaluation platform will be released after completion of artifact safety and reproducibility checks.
title_cn: EvoRiskBench：工作区智能体运行时安全风险的演化基准
abstract_cn: 工作区智能体把大语言模型与执行框架结合，执行访问或修改外部资源的有状态多步任务。现有基准在其运行时安全风险的可执行覆盖上存在缺口，而模型能力、框架、工具与威胁的不断演化也要求基准演化。我们提出 EvoRiskBench，一个围绕 EP-Path-EF 框架组织的演化基准：把初始风险入口经智能体中介的风险路径连接到一跳技术效果。框架定义九类入口与五类效果；一项 20 人研究支持其在代表性案例上的可解释性与分类一致性。在该框架引导下，自动化端到端工作流在隔离环境中构造并执行风险案例，并用运行时迹与环境状态独立验证结果。基准提供跨六个场景、450 个对抗任务的可复现数据集。我们评估横跨三个模型（GPT-5.6 Sol、DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813、Claude Opus 5）与三个框架（Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw）的九种模型-框架配置。结果显示系统普遍脆弱：最脆弱配置 Codex+DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 攻击成功率（ASR）达 68.44%，表明工作区智能体的配置不足以保证安全的自主执行。ASR 在模型间的差异大于框架间，且框架差异依赖于模型。基准案例与评估平台将在工件安全与可复现性检查完成后发布。
summary_cn: 工作区智能体安全基准 EvoRiskBench：9 入口×5 效果框架+450 对抗任务、迹与状态独立验证；9 种模型-框架配置普遍脆弱，最高 ASR 68.44%（Codex+DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813）。
objective_summary: 提出以 EP-Path-EF 分类组织的可演化、可执行验证的工作区智能体安全基准，构建 450 任务数据集并系统评估九种模型-框架配置的运行时风险暴露。
evidence_note: 450 个对抗任务、6 场景、9 种配置的自动端到端评估，运行时迹+环境状态独立验证结果，20 人标注一致性研究支持框架可解释性；模型与框架均为当前主力产品。
novelty_note: 智能体安全基准已有多个（ASB、AgentDojo 等），新意在于 EP-Path-EF 可演化分类、隔离环境自动构造与迹/状态独立验证的组合及对工作区框架维度的系统覆盖。
scope: 结论适用于所测三个模型、三个框架与六类工作区场景；对多智能体协作、长周期任务与防御机制部署后的表现未覆盖。
limitations: 自动构造的风险案例可能偏离真实攻击分布；只测裸配置未评估防御方案；工件尚未发布，独立复现暂不可行。

title: The Fragility of Trigger-Tag Mechanisms for Misuse Detection in Open-Weight LLMs
abstract: Open-weight language models can be downloaded, modified, and deployed beyond their developers' control, limiting the effectiveness of centrally enforced safeguards. Recent work has therefore proposed \emph{trigger-tag} mechanisms that produce a detectable signal when a model is used under a target condition, such as generating phishing contents. Although these mechanisms borrow from established techniques, their use for conditional misuse detection in open-weight LLMs is relatively new. Therefore, existing research works have not systematically studied the robustness of trigger-tag mechanisms under adversarial attacks. To close this gap, (i)~we formalize trigger-tags and distinguish \emph{token-level trigger-tags}, which introduce watermark-inspired signals during decoding, from \emph{weight-level trigger-tags}, which learn backdoor-inspired associations between target conditions and detectable model behavior. Furthermore, (ii)~we introduce \Untag, a unified attack framework that organizes their mechanism-specific attack surfaces into a common taxonomy. We evaluate representative token-level and weight-level trigger-tags using phishing as a case study. We find that while trigger-tags may provide useful evidence in controlled settings, our attacks render the existing trigger-tag mechanisms to be entirely ineffective. Consequently, we argue that these mechanisms should not be treated as robust misuse detectors when attackers can transform outputs or modify open weights.
title_cn: 开放权重 LLM 滥用检测中触发-标签机制的脆弱性
abstract_cn: 开放权重语言模型可被下载、修改并在开发者控制之外部署，限制了集中执行保障措施的有效性。近期工作因此提出触发-标签（trigger-tag）机制：当模型在目标条件（如生成钓鱼内容）下被使用时产生可检测信号。尽管这些机制借鉴了成熟技术，它们在开放权重 LLM 条件性滥用检测中的使用还比较新，因此已有研究尚未系统研究触发-标签机制在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性。为填补这一空白：(i) 我们形式化触发-标签，区分在解码期引入水印式信号的 token 级触发-标签，与学习目标条件和可检测模型行为间后门式关联的权重级触发-标签；(ii) 我们提出统一攻击框架 Untag，把两类机制特有的攻击面组织进共同分类。我们以钓鱼为案例评估代表性 token 级与权重级触发-标签。我们发现，虽然触发-标签在受控环境中可提供有用证据，我们的攻击使现有触发-标签机制完全失效。因此我们认为：当攻击者可以变换输出或修改开放权重时，这些机制不应被视为鲁棒的滥用检测器。
summary_cn: 形式化 token 级与权重级触发-标签两类滥用检测机制并提出统一攻击框架 Untag：以钓鱼为案例的评估表明现有机制在输出变换或权重修改下完全失效。
objective_summary: 形式化开放权重 LLM 的触发-标签滥用检测机制，提出统一攻击框架 Untag 并以钓鱼为案例系统评估两类机制的对抗鲁棒性，得出失效结论。
evidence_note: 对代表性 token 级与权重级机制系统攻击并报告完全失效，案例为钓鱼场景；评估限于单一滥用用例与代表性机制实现。
novelty_note: 首次系统研究触发-标签机制的对抗鲁棒性并给出统一攻击分类，阴性结论对该新方向具有界定性意义；个别攻击技术继承水印/后门攻击文献。
scope: 结论适用于可被攻击者变换输出或修改权重的开放权重场景；对推理服务端集中部署、多机制组合与检测端自适应加固未覆盖。
limitations: 仅以钓鱼为案例，其他滥用条件未测；攻击假设攻击者知晓机制存在；未探索可抵抗 Untag 的强化设计。

title: Securing Computer-Use Agents Against Branch Steering Attacks
abstract: Modern Computer Use Agents (CUAs) directly interact with graphical user interfaces and execute third-party web tools, exposing them to indirect prompt injection across every rendered page and tool response. While the Dual-LLM pattern is the primary system-level architecture offering formal security guarantees - using an isolated Planner LLM (P-LLM) to fix execution paths before processing untrusted inputs via a Quarantined LLM (Q-LLM) - these guarantees break down in graphical environments. Because CUA interaction is inherently dynamic, plans cannot remain data-independent; they must branch based on anticipated runtime web content - covering all possible cases the agent may encounter. This exposes agents to branch steering attacks, where an adversary crafts untrusted data to coerce a CUA down a hazardous, pre-approved branch without injecting explicit instructions. We systematically study branch steering attacks and introduce STEER-Bench (101 tasks across 9 domains), showing high attack success against both standard (94.4%) and vanilla Dual-LLM (89.5%) CUAs. We then propose COBRA, an architecture that pairs trusted branching plans with ahead-of-time capability constraints, strictly bounding the parameters and destinations each branch may execute. On STEER-Bench, COBRA reduces attack success to 0% while retaining 97% benign utility.
comment: 16 pages, including 2 figures. To be presented at the "Agents in the Wild" Workshop at the NeurIPS 2026 Conference
title_cn: 防护计算机使用智能体免受分支引导攻击
abstract_cn: 现代计算机使用智能体（CUA）直接操作图形界面并执行第三方 Web 工具，暴露于每个渲染页面与工具响应中的间接提示注入。Dual-LLM 模式是提供形式化安全保证的主要系统级架构——由隔离的规划 LLM（P-LLM）在经隔离 LLM（Q-LLM）处理不可信输入前固定执行路径——但这些保证在图形环境中失效。因为 CUA 交互本质是动态的，计划不可能与数据无关：必须依据预期的运行时 Web 内容分支，覆盖智能体可能遇到的所有情形。这使智能体暴露于分支引导攻击：攻击者构造不可信数据，把 CUA 胁迫到一条危险的、预先批准的分支上，而无需注入显式指令。我们系统研究分支引导攻击并提出 STEER-Bench（9 领域 101 任务）：标准 CUA 攻击成功率达 94.4%，原生 Dual-LLM 达 89.5%。我们随后提出 COBRA 架构：把可信分支计划与预先（ahead-of-time）能力约束配对，严格限定每个分支可执行的参数与目标。在 STEER-Bench 上，COBRA 把攻击成功率降到 0%，同时保持 97% 的良性效用。
summary_cn: 提出分支引导攻击与 STEER-Bench（9 领域 101 任务）：标准 CUA 与原生 Dual-LLM 的 ASR 达 94.4%/89.5%；防御 COBRA 用分支级能力约束把 ASR 降到 0%，良性效用保持 97%。
objective_summary: 系统定义并量化 CUA 的分支引导攻击（胁迫进入预批准危险分支），构建 101 任务基准 STEER-Bench，并提出以可信分支计划+分支级能力约束的 COBRA 防御架构。
evidence_note: 9 领域 101 任务的专用基准，标准 CUA、原生 Dual-LLM 与 COBRA 的对照评估给出 ASR 与良性效用数字；NeurIPS 2026 Agents in the Wild workshop；基准为自建。
novelty_note: 分支引导是新的攻击类：利用 Dual-LLM 形式化保证在动态 GUI 环境失效的结构性缺口（计划必须依赖不可信内容分支），配套的分支级先验能力约束防御亦新。
scope: 结论适用于图形界面 CUA 与 Dual-LLM 类架构及所测 101 任务；对非 GUI 智能体、更细粒度 UI 空间与自适应多轮攻击者未覆盖。
limitations: COBRA 需预先枚举分支及其能力约束，计划覆盖不全时防御出现缺口；良性效用 97% 意味着仍有任务降级；评估限于自建基准。

title: SecJev: Bringing Security Expertise to System One Decision Models
abstract: Security workflows need models that turn complex observations and explicit policies into decisions. System One models introduced by Jev return typed predictions and probabilities; security specialization supplies the domain expertise behind those predictions. We introduce SecJev, to our knowledge the first family of Jev-like decision models specialized for security, spanning 0.8B to 9B parameters. Built on Kev's single-pass candidate scorer, SecJev learns Boolean, choice, and ordered decisions from text, telemetry, and observation histories. We develop SecJev-Corpus to unify source-label prediction and explicit-policy evaluation across 14 tasks and eight sources. It covers tool outputs, traffic, federated updates, consensus, authentication, and vehicle messages. Scene-weighted training adapts the models across these domains while preserving a shared typed decision interface. Security specialization improves every model in the family; SecJev-0.8B outperforms general Kev-9B by 20.51 percentage points in task-macro accuracy. Comparisons with answer-only generative fine-tuning show close accuracy and latency with lower peak inference memory. Tests on new source groups reproduce gains over Kev in prompt-injection and traffic decisions, with capture-dependent false alarms. We release adapters, decision heads, SecJev-Corpus, and training and inference code.
comment: 22 pages, 1 figure
title_cn: SecJev：为 System-1 决策模型引入安全专长
abstract_cn: 安全工作流需要把复杂观测与显式策略转化为决策的模型。Jev 类 System-1 模型返回带类型的预测与概率；安全专门化则为这些预测提供领域专长。我们提出 SecJev——据我们所知首个面向安全的 Jev 类决策模型家族，参数量从 0.8B 到 9B。SecJev 基于 Kev 的单次候选打分器，从文本、遥测与观测历史学习布尔、选择与有序决策。我们构建 SecJev-Corpus，统一 14 个任务、8 个来源的源标签预测与显式策略评估，覆盖工具输出、流量、联邦更新、共识、认证与车联网消息。场景加权训练使模型在这些领域间适配，同时保持共享的类型化决策接口。安全专门化提升了家族中每个模型；SecJev-0.8B 在任务宏平均准确率上超过通用 Kev-9B 20.51 个百分点。与仅答案生成式微调的比较显示准确率与延迟相近且推理峰值内存更低。在新来源组上的测试复现了对 Kev 的增益（提示注入与流量决策），但存在依赖采集的误报。我们发布适配器、决策头、SecJev-Corpus 与训练推理代码。
summary_cn: 提出 0.8B–9B 安全专用决策模型家族 SecJev 与 14 任务/8 来源语料：SecJev-0.8B 宏准确率超通用 Kev-9B 20.51 pp 且峰值内存更低；新来源组复现增益但误报依赖采集。
objective_summary: 构建安全专长的 Jev 类决策模型家族与统一语料 SecJev-Corpus，覆盖布尔/选择/有序决策与多安全域，用场景加权训练与通用基线、生成式微调对照评估准确率、延迟与内存。
evidence_note: 14 任务、8 来源的自建统一语料，多规模家族对比通用 Kev-9B 与生成式微调，另设新来源组泛化测试并诚实报告采集依赖误报；无第三方基准与统计检验。
novelty_note: 首个面向安全域系统化的 Jev 类决策模型家族与统一类型化接口；训练方法为场景加权适配，属已有技术的领域化而非新范式。
scope: 结论适用于所测 8 类安全数据源与文本型决策任务；对多模态遥测、长上下文策略推理与对抗性分布漂移下的表现未覆盖。
limitations: 误报率依赖采集分布，换源可能漂移；语料为自建，外部有效性待第三方验证；0.8B 模型对复杂策略边界的可靠性未逐任务分析。

title: Beyond Predefined Sinks: Security-Aware Dependency Analysis for LLM Agents
abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents increasingly connect model-generated decisions to security-sensitive software capabilities such as command execution, filesystem access, network communication, browser control, and external tools. Existing analyses often use predefined sensitive operations as anchors, but operation identity alone is insufficient to determine security implications. We present AgentSecGraph, a security-aware static analysis framework that constructs a candidate-centered Security-Aware Agent Dependency Graph (Security-ADG) for each security-sensitive operation. It augments operation identity with agent relevance, source and dependency evidence, trust-boundary context, guard evidence, and external-effect semantics. We further introduce AgentSecBench, a corpus of 67 real-world LLM-agent repositories spanning 11 ecosystems and 37,542 source files. The current analyzer identifies 23,866 static security-sensitive operation candidates across 65 repositories and emits one Security-ADG artifact per candidate. Corpus-wide analysis recovers source-to-operation dependency evidence for 9,821 candidates (41.15%) and potential guard evidence for 3,075 (12.88%), completing in 50.8 minutes. Using a separate reproduction-backed evaluation layer, we establish 22 security-sensitive behaviors across 13 repositories: one confirmed vulnerability, one pending disclosure candidate, and 20 guarded behaviors. In nine held-out cases, Security-ADG preserves 91.1% of the reference context and all five observed guards, compared with 20.0% for a sink-only view and 40.0% for a simplified ADG. These results show that security-aware dependency and contextual evidence enable distinctions that cannot be recovered from sensitive-operation identity alone.
comment: 29 pages, 3 figures, including supplementary appendices. Preprint
title_cn: 超越预定义汇聚点：面向 LLM 智能体的安全感知依赖分析
abstract_cn: 基于 LLM 的智能体日益把模型生成的决策连接到安全敏感的软件能力：命令执行、文件系统访问、网络通信、浏览器控制与外部工具。现有分析常以预定义敏感操作为锚点，但仅凭操作身份不足以判定安全影响。我们提出 AgentSecGraph，一个安全感知静态分析框架，为每个安全敏感操作构建以候选为中心的安全感知智能体依赖图（Security-ADG）：在操作身份之外补充智能体相关性、来源与依赖证据、信任边界上下文、防护证据与外部效果语义。我们进一步提出 AgentSecBench：覆盖 11 个生态、37,542 个源文件的 67 个真实 LLM 智能体仓库语料。当前分析器在 65 个仓库中识别出 23,866 个静态安全敏感操作候选，每个候选产出一个 Security-ADG 工件。语料级分析为 9,821 个候选（41.15%）恢复来源到操作的依赖证据，为 3,075 个（12.88%）恢复潜在防护证据，耗时 50.8 分钟。用独立的以复现为支撑的评估层，我们在 13 个仓库确立 22 个安全敏感行为：一个确认漏洞、一个待披露候选与 20 个受防护行为。在九个留出案例上，Security-ADG 保留 91.1% 的参照上下文与全部五个观测防护，而仅汇聚点视图为 20.0%、简化 ADG 为 40.0%。结果表明安全感知依赖与上下文证据能做出仅凭敏感操作身份无法做出的区分。
summary_cn: 提出安全感知依赖图分析与 67 仓库语料：识别 23,866 个敏感操作候选，13 仓库确立 22 个敏感行为（含 1 确认漏洞），留出案例上下文保留 91.1%（仅汇聚点视图 20.0%）。
objective_summary: 构建面向 LLM 智能体仓库的安全感知静态分析框架与基准语料，以候选为中心的依赖图补充来源、防护、信任边界等证据，并用复现支撑的评估层验证区分能力。
evidence_note: 67 仓库、37,542 文件的大规模语料与 23,866 候选的全量分析（50.8 分钟），并用复现支撑的评估层在 13 仓库确立 22 个行为（1 确认漏洞）；确认漏洞数少、语料为快照。
novelty_note: 把安全敏感判定从操作身份扩展到上下文证据（来源、防护、信任边界、外部效果）是对智能体代码分析的新角度；静态分析组件本身成熟。
scope: 结论适用于所测 11 个生态的源码级智能体仓库与静态可恢复的证据；对动态行为、闭源服务与运行时绕过未覆盖。
limitations: 确认漏洞仅 1 个、待披露 1 个，漏洞发现产出有限；分析器覆盖 65/67 仓库；防护证据恢复率 12.88% 说明大量上下文仍不可静态恢复。

title: Digital Twin-Assisted Mapping of ICS Telemetry to ATT&CK for ICS with Evidence-Driven Dependency Reasoning
abstract: Reconstructing adversarial behavior from Industrial Control System (ICS) telemetry is difficult because process observations reveal physical changes more directly than the actions that produced them. This paper presents a Digital Twin (DT)-assisted framework that extracts synchronized state changes, converts them into evidence-preserving descriptions, maps them to ATT&CK for ICS through retrieval-augmented Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning, and constructs a typed dependency graph. Evaluation comprises a four-configuration ablation on nine held-out SWaT scenarios containing ten telemetry-evaluable ground-truth episodes, three independent generations of the principal mapping configurations, and external evaluation on BATADAL and WADI. Across the three SWaT generations, DT-enriched mapping produces fewer annotation-relative False Positive (FP) episodes in every run, with a mean per-run reduction of 34.1%. Both configurations obtain a mean recall of 0.633, although recall varies between 0.50 and 0.70 and DT enrichment does not improve F1 in every run. These observations are descriptive: the primary-run paired comparisons do not reach statistical significance, and the mapping advantage does not transfer to either external dataset. An exploratory positive-only dependency benchmark recovers eight of nine documented Co-occurrence relationships with DT context. A separate end-to-end benchmark containing one positive pair and 25 negative controls exposes propagation of mapping errors into unsupported edges. The findings identify both the potential and limitations of DT context for semantic security interpretation, without establishing reliable autonomous attribution, general causal reconstruction, or practical analyst benefit.
title_cn: 数字孪生辅助的 ICS 遥测到 ATT&CK for ICS 映射：证据驱动的依赖推理
abstract_cn: 从工业控制系统（ICS）遥测重建对抗行为很困难，因为过程观测比产生它们的动作更直接地揭示物理变化。本文提出数字孪生（DT）辅助框架：提取同步状态变化、将其转换为保留证据的描述、通过检索增强的大语言模型（LLM）推理映射到 ATT&CK for ICS，并构建类型化依赖图。评估包括：在九个留出 SWaT 场景（含十个可遥测评估的真值事件）上的四配置消融、主映射配置的三次独立生成，以及在 BATADAL 与 WADI 上的外部评估。在三次 SWaT 生成中，DT 增强映射在每次运行都产生更少的相对标注假阳性（FP）事件，每次运行平均降低 34.1%。两种配置的平均召回均为 0.633，但召回在 0.50–0.70 间波动，且 DT 增强并非在每次运行都改善 F1。这些观察是描述性的：主运行的配对比较未达统计显著，映射优势也不迁移到两个外部数据集。一项探索性正例依赖基准恢复了九个已记录共现关系中的八个（有 DT 上下文）。另一个包含一个正例对与 25 个负例对照的端到端基准暴露了映射错误向无依据边的传播。结果指出 DT 上下文对语义安全解释的潜力与局限，但不支持可靠的自主归因、一般因果重建或实际分析员收益。
summary_cn: 提出 DT+RAG LLM 的 ICS 遥测到 ATT&CK 映射框架：SWaT 上 FP 事件平均降 34.1%、召回 0.633，但未达统计显著且不迁移到 BATADAL/WADI；作者明示不支持自主归因与因果重建。
objective_summary: 构建数字孪生辅助的 ICS 遥测-ATT&CK 映射与依赖图框架，在 SWaT 消融、多次独立生成与外部数据集上评估 FP、召回与依赖恢复，并如实报告显著性与迁移局限。
evidence_note: 四配置消融、三次独立生成、九个留出场景与两个外部数据集，配对比较如实报告不显著（均值 FP 降 34.1%、召回 0.633）；真值事件仅 10 个、外部迁移为阴性。
novelty_note: DT 状态差分+RAG LLM 映射到 ATT&CK for ICS 的组合较新；对自身局限的诚实量化（不显著、不迁移）具有诊断价值。
scope: 结论适用于水处理类 ICS 测试床（SWaT/BATADAL/WADI）与所测 LLM 配置；对真实产线遥测、多阶段攻击链与其他行业协议未覆盖。
limitations: 配对比较未达统计显著、外部数据集不迁移；依赖图在端到端基准中出现无依据边传播；依赖 ATT&CK for ICS 覆盖与遥测质量。

title: Frequency Is Not Sensitivity Identifying Safety-Sensitive Experts in Sparse MoE LLM
abstract: Suppressing a small set of routed experts can weaken the safety behavior of a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model without retraining. Which experts to suppress is therefore a security question, and the usual answer is activation frequency, but frequency measures use, not influence. We test an alternative: router-gradient sensitivity, the sensitivity of the sequence loss to the gate weights that select an expert. Across five MoE architectures, we rank experts by each signal on 500 benign and 500 malicious prompts and measure refusal on 100 held-out malicious prompts under two budgets: equal expert counts and equal nominal malicious routing traffic (1%-5%). Under each of the two budgets, router-gradient selection reduces refusals more than activation in 24 of 25 conditions, and more than a ten-trial random mean in all 25. The largest effect is in OLMoE, where refusals fall from 34 to 9 of 100 prompts (73.53% relative) with no degraded outputs, indicating substantive compliance rather than broken generation. After matching expert counts in every layer, gradient selection still produces greater refusal reduction than activation in 23 of 25 conditions, with two ties. An exploratory cross-model analysis links larger malicious-versus-benign concentration gaps to greater peak gradient effects (rho = 0.90; exact two-sided p = 0.083, n = 5). Together, the results support gradient selection under the tested budgets.
title_cn: 频率不等于敏感度：识别稀疏 MoE LLM 中的安全敏感专家
abstract_cn: 抑制一小组被路由到的专家就能在不重训练的情况下削弱稀疏混合专家（MoE）语言模型的安全行为。抑制哪些专家因此成为安全问题，通常的答案是激活频率，但频率度量的是使用而非影响。我们检验另一个信号：路由器梯度敏感度，即序列损失对选择专家的门控权重的敏感度。我们在五个 MoE 架构上，分别按两种信号对 500 个良性提示与 500 个恶意提示排序专家，并在两个预算（等专家数与等名义恶意路由流量，1%–5%）下测量 100 个留出恶意提示上的拒绝率。在每种预算下，路由器梯度选择在 25 个条件中的 24 个造成比激活频率更大的拒绝下降，且在全部 25 个条件中高于十次随机试验均值。最大效应出现在 OLMoE：拒绝从 100 个提示中的 34 降到 9（相对下降 73.53%），且无退化输出，表明是实质性服从而非生成损坏。在每一层匹配专家数后，梯度选择仍在 25 个条件中的 23 个产生更大拒绝下降（两次平局）。一项探索性跨模型分析把更大的恶意-良性集中度差距与更大的峰值梯度效应联系起来（ρ=0.90；精确双侧 p=0.083，n=5）。结果支持在所测预算下采用梯度选择。
summary_cn: 在 5 个稀疏 MoE 架构上证明路由器梯度敏感度比激活频率更能定位安全关键专家：等预算下 24/25 条件造成更大拒绝下降，OLMoE 拒绝从 34/100 降到 9/100（-73.53%）且无输出退化。
objective_summary: 提出以路由器梯度敏感度替代激活频率来识别抑制后会削弱 MoE 安全行为的专家，在五个架构、两类预算与留出提示上系统比较两种信号的拒绝率下降效应。
evidence_note: 五个 MoE 架构、500+500 提示排序、100 留出提示评估、等专家数与等流量两种预算、随机基线与逐层匹配对照，并报告精确显著性（探索性分析 p=0.083）。
novelty_note: 以梯度敏感度替代使用频率来定位安全关键组件是有诊断价值的新信号；专家抑制削弱安全的现象已有报道，本文修正了选择准则。
scope: 结论适用于所测五个稀疏 MoE 架构与 1%–5% 抑制预算；对密集模型、更小预算与部署方的防御性屏蔽策略未直接覆盖。
limitations: 跨模型关联分析为探索性（n=5，p=0.083）；拒绝率作为安全代理依赖提示集；未提出抑制检测或恢复机制，对防御方启示有限。

title: AgentTrap: Stateful Feedback Deception against Autonomous Penetration Testing Agents
abstract: Autonomous penetration testing agents conduct multi-step attacks by continuously adapting their plans and actions to target responses. As a common defense, honeypots can be deployed to divert these agents from real assets by presenting decoy services, while also supporting attack tracing and active counterattacks. However, conventional honeypots rely primarily on static artifacts and predefined responses, leaving them unable to adapt to the evolving attack strategies of autonomous penetration testing agents. To this end, we present AgentTrap, the first closed-loop honeypot tailored for autonomous penetration testing agents. AgentTrap uses sentinel endpoints to avoid benign interference, stateful deception grounded in the protected application, and behavior-guided escalation to sustain engagement and collect agent-side behavioral evidence with controlled disclosures. We evaluate AgentTrap against eight autonomous penetration-testing agents in a deployed web application containing a real application endpoint and a separate honeypot endpoint configured under three defense strategies. Compared with no defense, AgentTrap reduces the aggregate real-target attack success rate from 95.8% to 79.2% and successfully elicits attacker API keys in 18.8% of the runs, outperforming static deception and fixed escalation. Furthermore, trace analysis shows that resistance to such counterattacks depends jointly on model-level recognition of deceptive requests and architecture-level isolation of sensitive resources.
comment: 4 pages
title_cn: AgentTrap：针对自主渗透测试智能体的有状态反馈欺骗
abstract_cn: 自主渗透测试智能体通过持续依据目标响应调整计划与动作来执行多步攻击。蜜罐作为常见防御，可通过呈现诱饵服务转移智能体对真实资产的注意，并支持攻击追踪与主动反制。然而传统蜜罐主要依赖静态工件与预定义响应，无法适应自主渗透测试智能体不断演化的攻击策略。为此我们提出 AgentTrap——首个面向自主渗透测试智能体的闭环蜜罐。AgentTrap 使用哨兵端点避免误伤良性流量，以基于受保护应用的有状态欺骗维持交互，并通过行为引导升级在受控披露下收集攻击者侧行为证据。我们在部署了真实应用端点与独立蜜罐端点（三种防御策略配置）的 Web 应用上，对八个自主渗透测试智能体评估 AgentTrap。与无防御相比，AgentTrap 把真实目标的总体攻击成功率从 95.8% 降到 79.2%，并在 18.8% 的运行中成功诱导出攻击者 API 密钥，优于静态欺骗与固定升级。迹分析进一步表明，对此类反制的抵抗力同时取决于模型层对欺骗请求的识别与架构层对敏感资源的隔离。
summary_cn: 首个面向自主渗透测试智能体的闭环蜜罐 AgentTrap：在 8 个智能体的对比实验中把真实目标攻击成功率从 95.8% 降到 79.2%，18.8% 运行中诱导出攻击者 API 密钥，优于静态欺骗与固定升级。
objective_summary: 提出 AgentTrap 闭环蜜罐：哨兵端点分流、有状态欺骗与行为引导升级收集智能体侧行为证据，在含真实端点的 Web 应用上对八个渗透测试智能体量化防御效果。
evidence_note: 8 个自主渗透测试智能体、真实应用端点+蜜罐端点的部署实验，对比无防御/静态欺骗/固定升级三种配置，报告 ASR 与密钥诱导率；单一 Web 应用场景、4 页短文。
novelty_note: 把蜜罐从静态工件升级为面向智能体的有状态闭环欺骗（哨兵分流+行为引导升级）是新组合；蜜罐与欺骗防御本身是成熟方向。
scope: 结论适用于 Web 应用类目标与所测八个渗透测试智能体；对非 Web 协议、更强适应性的攻击者与长周期对抗未覆盖。
limitations: 真实目标 ASR 仍高达 79.2%，防御不完全；诱导密钥率 18.8% 依赖智能体架构未隔离敏感资源；评估限于单一受控应用且篇幅短、实验细节有限。

title: Containing the Autonomous Operator: A Defense-in-Depth Framework and Reference Architecture for Securing AI Agents on Kubernetes
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are moving from chat interfaces into infrastructure operations, where they read telemetry, call tools, generate and execute code, and change the state of production Kubernetes clusters. This collapses a boundary that conventional cloud-native security assumes: the boundary between data and control. Content that an agent merely reads (a log line, a ticket, a tool description) can redirect what it does. This paper argues that the model must not be treated as a security boundary and that agent safety on Kubernetes is therefore an infrastructure problem: every guarantee must continue to hold under the assumption that the agent is fully compromised by prompt injection. We contribute (i) a threat model and ten-class threat taxonomy for agents operating on and within Kubernetes, aligned with emerging OWASP guidance for agentic applications; (ii) nine design principles, centered on complete mediation at the tool boundary and on breaking the combination of untrusted input, sensitive access, and external egress; (iii) a seven-layer defense-in-depth framework that maps each principle to native or widely adopted Kubernetes mechanisms: workload identity, RBAC and ValidatingAdmissionPolicy, gVisor/Kata sandboxing via the SIG Apps Agent Sandbox project, FQDN-aware egress policy, an agent/MCP gateway with policy-as-code over tool arguments, and eBPF runtime enforcement; (iv) a reference architecture with concrete policy artifacts and per-layer bindings for Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service, and Google Kubernetes Engine; and (v) a qualitative evaluation comprising a threat-control coverage matrix and four attack walkthroughs, with a proposed empirical methodology. We report no measured attack-success or overhead figures; instead we identify residual risks and the measurements needed to validate the framework.
comment: 22 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables, 6 listings
title_cn: 约束自主操作员：Kubernetes 上 AI 智能体安全的纵深防御框架与参考架构
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正从聊天界面走向基础设施运维：读取遥测、调用工具、生成并执行代码、改变生产 Kubernetes 集群状态。这坍塌了传统云原生安全假定的边界——数据与控制的边界。智能体仅仅读取的内容（日志行、工单、工具描述）可以改变它的行为。本文论证不能把模型当作安全边界，Kubernetes 上的智能体安全因此是基础设施问题：每一项保证都必须在智能体被提示注入完全攻陷的假设下继续成立。我们贡献：(i) 与新兴 OWASP 智能体应用指引对齐的威胁模型与十类威胁分类，覆盖在 Kubernetes 之上及之内运行的智能体；(ii) 九条设计原则，核心是工具边界的完全中介，以及切断不可信输入、敏感访问与外部出站的组合；(iii) 七层纵深防御框架，把每条原则映射到原生或广泛采用的 Kubernetes 机制：工作负载身份、RBAC 与 ValidatingAdmissionPolicy、经 SIG Apps Agent Sandbox 项目的 gVisor/Kata 沙箱、FQDN 感知的出站策略、对工具参数实施策略即代码的智能体/MCP 网关、eBPF 运行时强制；(iv) 为 Amazon EKS、Azure Kubernetes Service 与 Google Kubernetes Engine 给出具体策略工件与逐层绑定的参考架构；(v) 定性评估：威胁-控制覆盖矩阵与四个攻击走查，并提出实证方法论。我们不报告测得的攻击成功率或开销数字，而是识别剩余风险与验证框架所需的测量。
summary_cn: 提出 Kubernetes 上 LLM 智能体的纵深防御框架：十类威胁分类、九条设计原则、七层原生机制映射与三大云参考架构；纯定性评估（覆盖矩阵+四条攻击走查），无实测数字。
objective_summary: 面向假设智能体被提示注入完全攻陷的威胁模型，给出 Kubernetes 智能体的威胁分类、设计原则、七层纵深防御框架与三大托管云的参考架构，并以覆盖矩阵与攻击走查做定性评估。
evidence_note: 作者明言不报告实测攻击成功率或开销数字；证据为威胁-控制覆盖矩阵与四个攻击走查的定性分析，并提出后续实证方法论。
novelty_note: 机制均为现有 Kubernetes 能力（RBAC、gVisor/Kata、eBPF 等）的新场景组合：以「模型非安全边界」为公理的七层映射与智能体专属威胁分类是其组织性贡献。
scope: 结论适用于 Kubernetes 环境中运行基础设施运维类智能体的架构设计；对无 Kubernetes 的部署、模型层防御与跨集群联邦场景未覆盖。
limitations: 无实测攻击成功率与性能开销；策略工件需各云厂商逐一适配并维护；对智能体与网关自身实现漏洞（如 MCP 网关被绕过）未深入。

title: RMCW: A Deletion-Robust Watermark Based on Reed--Muller Codes for Language Models
abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) watermarking provides a lightweight mechanism for identifying text generated by a specific model, but its robustness remains fragile under post-processing attacks. Deletion attacks are particularly challenging because they shift token positions and break the alignment between observed tokens and their original watermark positions. We propose Reed--Muller Code Watermarking (RMCW), an LLM watermarking method based on Reed--Muller codes. In contrast to global codeword recovery, RMCW searches for surviving local algebraic structure, leveraging the Reed--Solomon consistency induced by affine-line restrictions of Reed--Muller codewords. During generation, RMCW injects a Reed--Muller structure into the sequence via a secret-keyed vocabulary partition. During detection, it maps the given text to keyed vocabulary bins and tests local subsequences for low-degree Reed--Solomon consistency using Berlekamp--Welch tests. Experiments on C4 and ELI5 datasets with OPT-1.3B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct show that RMCW preserves strong clean-text detectability and outperforms or matches the baseline methods under several deletion and rewriting attacks. Our code is available at https://github.com/BaichengDanny/RMCW.
title_cn: RMCW：基于 Reed–Muller 码的语言模型删除鲁棒水印
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）水印为识别特定模型生成的文本提供轻量机制，但在后处理攻击下鲁棒性仍脆弱。删除攻击尤其棘手，因为它们移动 token 位置，破坏观测 token 与原水印位置的对齐。我们提出 RMCW（Reed–Muller 码水印），一种基于 Reed–Muller 码的 LLM 水印方法。与全局码字恢复不同，RMCW 搜索幸存的局部代数结构，利用 Reed–Muller 码字仿射线限制诱导的 Reed–Solomon 一致性。生成时，RMCW 经密钥控制的词表划分向序列注入 Reed–Muller 结构；检测时，把文本映射到带密钥的词表桶，并用 Berlekamp–Welch 检验测试局部子序列的低次 Reed–Solomon 一致性。在 C4 与 ELI5 数据集、OPT-1.3B 与 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上的实验显示，RMCW 保持强干净文本可检测性，并在多种删除与改写攻击下优于或持平基线方法。代码见 https://github.com/BaichengDanny/RMCW。
summary_cn: 基于 Reed–Muller 码的删除鲁棒水印 RMCW：密钥词表划分注入结构、局部 Berlekamp–Welch 检验检测，在 C4/ELI5 与 OPT-1.3B、Llama-3.1-8B 上删除/改写攻击下优于或持平基线。
objective_summary: 提出 RMCW，用 Reed–Muller 码的仿射线局部代数结构抵抗删除攻击造成的位置错位，生成端密钥词表划分注入、检测端局部 Berlekamp–Welch 检验，并在两数据集两模型上对比基线。
evidence_note: C4 与 ELI5、OPT-1.3B 与 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上系统对比多种删除与改写攻击下的基线，报告干净文本可检测性保持；规模中等、无统计检验说明。
novelty_note: 以纠错码局部代数结构对抗位置偏移是水印鲁棒性的新机制组合；与基于窗口/语义的水印相比路线不同，为该问题引入编码理论工具。
scope: 结论适用于所测两个模型与数据集及文本水印场景；对更强自适应攻击（如知情生成器干扰、跨段拼接）与多语言未覆盖。
limitations: 低次一致性检验对高比例删除与重写后的残余结构仍有要求；密钥词表划分可能影响文本质量，需权衡；评估未含与最新语义水印的全面对比。

title: From TS-SUF-2 to TS-SUF-4: Practical Security Enhancements for FROST2 Threshold Signatures
abstract: Threshold signature schemes play a vital role in securing digital assets within blockchain and distributed systems. FROST2 stands out as a practical threshold Schnorr signature scheme, noted for its efficiency and compatibility with standard verification processes. However, under the one-more discrete logarithm assumption, with static corruption and centralized key generation settings, FROST2 has been shown by Bellare et al. (in CRYPTO 2022) to achieve only TS-SUF-2 security, which is a consequence of its vulnerability to TS-UF-3 attacks. In this paper, we address this security limitation by presenting an enhanced variant of FROST2, namely, FROST2+ which achieves the TS-SUF-4 security level under the same computational assumptions as the original FROST2. FROST2+ strengthens FROST2 by integrating additional pre-processing token verifications that help mitigate TS-UF-3 and TS-UF-4 vulnerabilities while maintaining practical efficiency. We show that FROST2+ can achieve TS-SUF-4 security not only under the same conditions as the original FROST2 analysis, but also when initialized with a distributed key generation protocol such as PedPoP. Our benchmark using ZCash's FROST library shows that the performance of FROST2+ is comparable to FROST2 and about 64-79% faster than FROST when precomputation is enabled.
title_cn: 从 TS-SUF-2 到 TS-SUF-4：FROST2 门限签名的实用安全增强
abstract_cn: 门限签名方案对保护区块链与分布式系统中的数字资产至关重要。FROST2 是实用的门限 Schnorr 签名方案，以效率和与标准验证流程的兼容性著称。然而 Bellare 等人（CRYPTO 2022）证明：在 One-More 离散对数假设、静态腐化与集中式密钥生成设定下，FROST2 仅达 TS-SUF-2 安全，这是其易受 TS-UF-3 攻击的后果。本文针对这一安全局限提出增强变体 FROST2+，在与原 FROST2 相同的计算假设下达到 TS-SUF-4 安全级别。FROST2+ 通过集成额外的预处理令牌验证来缓解 TS-UF-3 与 TS-UF-4 弱点，同时保持实用效率。我们证明 FROST2+ 不仅在原分析相同条件下达到 TS-SUF-4，在以 PedPoP 等分布式密钥生成协议初始化时亦然。基于 ZCash FROST 库的基准测试显示，FROST2+ 性能与 FROST2 相当，启用预计算时比 FROST 快约 64–79%。
summary_cn: 提出 FROST2+：预处理令牌验证使 FROST2 在相同假设下从 TS-SUF-2 升到 TS-SUF-4（含 PedPoP 密钥生成）；ZCash 库实测性能相当，预计算下快 64–79%。
objective_summary: 分析 FROST2 的 TS-UF-3 弱点，提出集成预处理令牌验证的 FROST2+ 并证明其 TS-SUF-4 安全性（含分布式密钥生成设定），以 ZCash FROST 库基准验证实用性。
evidence_note: 在与 Bellare 等（CRYPTO 2022）相同假设下给出 TS-SUF-4 证明（含 PedPoP 初始化情形），并有 ZCash FROST 库的实测基准（与 FROST2 性能相当、较 FROST 提速 64–79%）。
novelty_note: 在已部署方案上把安全级别从 TS-SUF-2 提升到 TS-SUF-4 是实质性改进；机制为对 FROST 预处理令牌添加验证，属已有构造的强化。
scope: 结论适用于 FROST2/FROST 系门限 Schnorr 签名及所测 ZCash FROST 库实现；对其他门限 ECDSA 或自适应腐化等不同腐化模型未覆盖。
limitations: 安全仍基于 One-More 离散对数假设与静态腐化设定；额外令牌验证增加交互开销；基准限于参考实现，未覆盖大规模签名方场景。

title: Inner Momentum for Differentially Private Muon
abstract: Differentially private training clips each per-example gradient before adding noise. This clipping is radial for each example, yet unequal clipping factors can distort the relative singular-vector geometry of their average. Muon is particularly exposed to this effect, since its update is an approximate polar factor UV^T that depends only on the singular vectors that clipping can shift. To curb this degradation, we propose averaging each sampled example's Muon gradient over the current model and a short history of recent models before clipping. The clipped batch matrix then separates into a common rescaling and a covariance residual R between sampled gradients and clipping values, with ||R||_F <= sigma_lambda sigma_G, bounding the clipping-induced distortion directly. We further show that a finite Newton-Schulz iteration preserves the polar factor of its input under these spectral conditions, confirming that our correction survives orthogonalization. In private GPT-2 fine-tuning on E2E and DART at epsilon in {1, 2, 4, 8}, DP-Muon-IM improves BLEU and ROUGE-L over DP-Muon in every seed-matched comparison, and non-private diagnostics show 2-4% lower pre-noise polar error.

title_cn: 差分隐私 Muon 的内部动量
abstract_cn: 差分隐私训练在加噪前对每个样本的梯度做裁剪。这种裁剪对每个样本是径向的，但不等的裁剪系数会扭曲其平均值的相对奇异向量几何。Muon 对此尤其敏感，因为其更新是仅依赖奇异向量的近似极分解因子 UV^T。为抑制这一退化，我们提出在裁剪前把每个样本的 Muon 梯度在当前模型与近期模型的短历史上取平均。裁剪后的批矩阵随即分解为一个公共缩放与一个样本梯度对裁剪值的协方差残差 R，且 ||R||_F ≤ σ_λ σ_G，直接界定裁剪导致的畸变。我们进一步证明在给定谱条件下，有限次 Newton–Schulz 迭代保持输入的极因子，确认我们的修正在正交化后仍然存续。在 E2E 与 DART 上的私有 GPT-2 微调、ε∈{1,2,4,8} 下，DP-Muon-IM 在每个种子配对比较中都提高 BLEU 与 ROUGE-L；非私有诊断显示预噪声极误差降低 2–4%。
summary_cn: 提出 DP-Muon-IM：裁剪前对短期模型历史 Muon 梯度取平均以保持奇异向量几何，并给出畸变界；GPT-2 私有微调（ε=1–8）所有种子配对比较均提升 BLEU/ROUGE-L。
objective_summary: 分析 DP 裁剪对 Muon 极分解更新的几何畸变，提出基于短历史的梯度内动量校正，证明修正经 Newton–Schulz 正交化后仍有效，并在 GPT-2 私有微调上验证。
evidence_note: E2E 与 DART 两数据集、ε∈{1,2,4,8} 四档、所有种子配对比较均有提升，附非私有诊断（极误差降 2–4%）与理论畸变界；对象限于 GPT-2 规模微调。
novelty_note: 动量式平均是已有技术，用于修复 DP 裁剪对 Muon 的奇异向量畸变属增量改进；理论界与正交化存续性分析为配套贡献。
scope: 结论适用于 Muon 类极分解优化器的 DP 训练与所测 GPT-2 规模微调；更大模型、其他架构与视觉任务未覆盖。
limitations: 历史平均增加内存与实现复杂度；仅在两个语言数据集上验证；畸变界的常数在实际训练中的影响未量化到端到端效用。

title: Differential Privacy of Gradient Descent on Perturbed Objectives
abstract: Objective perturbation adds a random linear term to a regularized empirical risk and releases the exact perturbed minimizer. We study the finite computation obtained by releasing the $N$-th iterate of deterministic gradient descent on $w\mapsto F(w;S)+\langle z,w\rangle$, where $z\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2I_d)$ is drawn once before optimization. For strongly convex and smooth objectives with Lipschitz Hessian, we prove an explicit condition under which the map $z\mapsto w_N$ is a $C^1$-diffeomorphism on the bounded domains used in the privacy argument, with a quantitative lower bound on the smallest singular value of its Jacobian. This permits a direct change-of-variables analysis of the finite iterate. For generalized linear models, the resulting privacy-profile bound has no explicit ambient-dimension factor once the iteration condition holds, and its finite-iteration correction decreases geometrically. By letting the free truncation parameter grow slowly with $N$, we recover the corresponding exact-minimizer certificate in the limit. We also bound the expected excess empirical risk by $d\sigma^2/(2\mu)$ plus a geometrically decreasing optimization term, and transfer the result to population risk without an additional multiplicative condition-number factor in the leading statistical terms.

title_cn: 扰动目标上梯度下降的差分隐私
abstract_cn: 目标扰动在正则化经验风险上加入随机线性项并发布精确的扰动极小化器。我们研究有限计算下的情形：发布确定性梯度下降在 w↦F(w;S)+⟨z,w⟩ 上的第 N 次迭代，其中 z∼N(0,σ²I_d) 在优化前一次性抽取。对强凸、光滑且 Hessian Lipschitz 的目标，我们证明一个显式条件，在该条件下映射 z↦w_N 是隐私论证所用有界域上的 C¹ 微分同胚，并给出其雅可比最小奇异值的定量下界。这允许对有限迭代做直接的变量替换分析。对广义线性模型，只要迭代条件成立，所得隐私曲线界不再含显式环境维数因子，且有限迭代修正项几何衰减。让自由截断参数随 N 缓慢增长，可在极限下恢复相应的精确极小化器证书。我们还把期望超额经验风险界定为 dσ²/(2μ) 加几何衰减的优化项，并在无需额外乘性条件数因子的前提下把结果迁移到总体风险的主导统计项。
summary_cn: 证明目标扰动下梯度下降第 N 次迭代的 DP 保证：经 C¹ 微分同胚变量替换分析，广义线性模型的隐私曲线界去掉环境维数因子、修正项几何衰减，极限恢复精确极小化器证书。
objective_summary: 分析目标扰动机制中有限次梯度下降迭代的差分隐私：给出 z↦w_N 为微分同胚的显式条件与雅可比下界，推导无维数因子的隐私曲线界与超额风险界。
evidence_note: 50 页理论工作：微分同胚条件、雅可比奇异值定量下界、无维数因子的隐私界与总体风险迁移均有证明；摘要未提及数值实验佐证实际常数。
novelty_note: 把目标扰动分析从精确极小化器推广到有限迭代本身，变量替换加定量雅可比下界是新的技术处理；相对已知目标扰动结论属实质性延伸而非全新路线。
scope: 结论适用于强凸、光滑、Hessian Lipschitz 目标与广义线性模型；非凸目标、随机优化与自适应组合未覆盖。
limitations: 隐私界成立需迭代条件（强凸等假设）；截断参数需随 N 缓慢增长；无实验验证常数项在实际设置中的量级。

title: When Normalization Selects the Sign: Auditing Robustness Ablations in Quantum Attention
abstract: Removing an input-scaling module changes both a classifier and the perturbations reaching its encoder. A robustness difference can therefore reflect the comparison rule as well as the module. We demonstrate this problem in a four-qubit quantum-attention detector on generated power-grid trajectories. A learned scaling module appears beneficial at a fixed physical attack budget, but matching an upper bound on perturbations at the encoder reverses the ordering. Neither comparison alone establishes a robustness benefit caused by the module. The initial test also perturbs clean examples into attacked examples while retaining their original labels; tests restricted to already attacked examples do not establish a benefit. Replacing a trained model's input scales disrupts detection. Retraining its linear classification layer restores the detection rate, but changes individual predictions, leaving the comparison descriptive rather than causal. Two further design checks explain why the input quantum Fisher information regularizer cannot train this model's query parameters, and why removing confidence bounds does not establish a larger certified radius. The evidence is limited to ten seeds, exact simulation, synthetic data, and a restricted set of attacks; classical baselines achieve better clean prediction. The practical lesson is to specify which perturbation budget is fixed, check that attacks preserve labels and interventions preserve predictions, and distinguish exploratory controls from confirmatory evidence.

title_cn: 当归一化选择符号：量子注意力鲁棒性消融的审计
abstract_cn: 移除输入缩放模块会同时改变分类器与到达编码器的扰动。因此鲁棒性差异可能反映比较规则而非模块本身。我们在四比特量子注意力检测器（用于电网生成轨迹）上演示这一问题。在固定物理攻击预算下，学习到的缩放模块看似有益，但在编码器处匹配扰动上界的比较会逆转排序。两种比较都不能单独确立由该模块带来的鲁棒性收益。初始测试还把干净样本扰动为受攻击样本同时保留原标签；仅限已受攻击样本的测试无法确立收益。替换训练模型的输入缩放会破坏检测，重训其线性分类层可恢复检测率，但改变个体预测，使该比较停留在描述性而非因果性。另两项设计检查解释了为何输入量子 Fisher 信息正则项无法训练该模型的 query 参数，以及为何移除置信界不能确立更大的认证半径。证据限于十个种子、精确仿真、合成数据与受限攻击集；经典基线在干净预测上更好。实践教训是：明确固定哪个扰动预算、检查攻击保持标签、干预保持预测，并区分探索性对照与确证性证据。
summary_cn: 审计量子注意力攻击检测器的鲁棒性消融：固定预算与匹配编码器扰动的两种比较给出相反排序，标签保持与预测保持检查缺失时收益不成立；证据限于 10 种子、合成数据与精确仿真。
objective_summary: 以四比特量子注意力检测器为对象，审计输入缩放模块鲁棒性消融中的比较规则、标签保持与因果性问题，并给出扰动预算规范与探索性/确证性对照的方法论教训。
evidence_note: 作者自陈证据限于十个种子、精确仿真、合成数据与受限攻击集，且经典基线干净预测更好；结论以方法论教训为主，非大规模实证。
novelty_note: 所揭示的消融陷阱（扰动预算错配、标签污染、干预改变预测）在对抗评估中已有讨论，新意在于其在量子注意力安全模型上的具体演示。
scope: 结论适用于小规模量子-注意力安全检测器的消融评估实践；对大规模模型、真实电网数据与其他量子架构未覆盖。

title: Where Quantum Fourier Sampling Stops Short: A Three-Gate Audit Protocol for Delay-PUF Security Models
abstract: Quantum Fourier sampling may help audit the spectral learnability of delay-based physical unclonable functions (PUFs). We ask whether that promise survives access matching, a strong classical comparator, and oracle synthesis. Three gates structure the evaluation. Structure: low degree is not small support at reachable challenge lengths; for 4-XOR at $n=14$, degree $\le d_f(0.1)$ admits $91\%$ of all $2^n$ characters and the median $90\%$-mass set spans a third of the spectrum. Algorithmics: constructing the phase oracle logically implies classical membership access, making Kushilevitz--Mansour the correct baseline; across 45 tasks it exhausts each finite domain, and no 4-XOR ideal-sampling case reaches $90\%$ mass within $2^n$ calls. A quantum-kernel diagnostic appears more favorable, with geometric difference rising to $2.151$ at $N=512$ challenges, but it correlates $0.991$ with $1/\sqrt{\lambda_{\min}(K_C)}$ for the classical Gram matrix $K_C$, and the 4-XOR label-complexity ratio does not exceed a balance-preserving permutation null ($p=0.930$). Trace-normalized geometric difference can therefore grow through classical ill-conditioning alone, without task-label alignment. Implementation: a simulator-validated fixed-point phase oracle based on the quantum Fourier transform admits an $18.9\%$ routed-depth reduction, yet the least certified precisions have estimated durations of $1.18$--$1.55\times$ the median dephasing time $T_2$ of the mapped qubits on a static backend snapshot, without hardware execution. We find no end-to-end advantage in the evaluated regime, although ideal sampling does use fewer coherent calls on the thresholded task. The contribution is the Three-Gate Quantum Audit Protocol: a reproducible procedure separating an ideal query advantage from a realizable security benefit. This is not a claim about deployed silicon and not an impossibility result.

title_cn: 量子傅里叶采样在哪里止步：延迟 PUF 安全模型的三门审计协议
abstract_cn: 量子傅里叶采样或有助于审计基于延迟的物理不可克隆函数（PUF）的谱可学习性。我们追问，在访问匹配、强经典比较器与预言机合成面前，这一前景是否成立。评估由三道门构成。结构：在可达挑战长度上，低次数并不等于小支撑集；对 n=14 的 4-XOR，次数 ≤ d_f(0.1) 容纳全部 2^n 个字符中的 91%，而中位 90% 质量集合跨越谱的三分之一。算法：构造相位预言机在逻辑上蕴含经典成员访问，使 Kushilevitz–Mansour 成为正确基线；跨 45 个任务它穷尽每个有限域，且没有 4-XOR 理想采样情形在 2^n 次调用内达到 90% 质量。一个量子核诊断看起来更有利，几何差在 N=512 挑战时升至 2.151，但它与经典 Gram 矩阵 K_C 的 1/√λ_min(K_C) 相关达 0.991，且 4-XOR 标签复杂度比不超过保持平衡的置换零假设（p=0.930）。因此迹归一化几何差可以仅凭经典病态增长，而无需任务标签对齐。实现：经模拟器验证的定点相位预言机（基于量子傅里叶变换）路由深度降低 18.9%，但最低认证精度的估计时长已达映射比特中位退相干时间 T₂ 的 1.18–1.55 倍（静态后端快照），且未做硬件执行。我们在所评估范围内未发现端到端优势，尽管理想采样在阈值化任务上确实使用更少相干调用。本文贡献是三门量子审计协议：一个把理想查询优势与可实现安全收益分离的可复现流程。这不是对已部署芯片的论断，也不是不可能性结果。
summary_cn: 提出三门审计协议并得阴性结论：结构、算法、实现三道门下量子傅里叶采样对延迟 PUF 无端到端优势（45 任务上 KM 基线穷尽有限域，定点预言机时长达 T₂ 的 1.18–1.55 倍）。
objective_summary: 以结构、算法、实现三道门系统审计量子傅里叶采样审计延迟 PUF 的前景，给出谱结构、Kushilevitz–Mansour 基线、量子核诊断与定点相位预言机实现的可复现流程与阴性结果。
evidence_note: 跨 45 个任务的穷尽分析、量子核诊断与置换零假设检验（p=0.930）、模拟器验证的定点预言机；NeurIPS 2026 SaTQuML workshop 录用；无硬件执行。
novelty_note: 把理想查询优势与可实现安全收益分离的审计协议是该方向的新方法论；结论为对乐观预期的诊断性修正而非新攻击或新原语。
scope: 结论限于所评估的 4-XOR 延迟 PUF 模型、可达挑战长度与静态后端快照，非对已部署硅片的论断；其他 PUF 族与容错量子设备未覆盖。

title: Pincer: Resource Authorization for Agents using a Digital Twin
abstract: Coding agents have become increasingly long-horizon, autonomous, reliant on general-purpose shell and maintain their own persistent memory for self-improvement. While these capabilities have made the agents powerful, they have also made them harder to defend against external adversaries. Defenses that restrict this architecture --- typed tools, information-flow control, or policy prediction engines --- give up too much functionality to be adopted. Agents deployed today (e.g. Claude, Codex) rely on a combination of user-mediated and automode sandboxing as their primary defense. In user-mediated sandboxing, user-maintained policies decay over time and repeated permission requests cause user fatigue, while auto mode's tool-call classifiers learn no user-specific policy and are not meant to defend against adversarial setups. Pincer is a new defense that operates at the resource layer and works alongside existing defenses at the tool-call layer like the auto mode. At the core of Pincer lies a digital twin, an isolated-context model that automatically learns and enforces dynamic user-specific least-privilege policies. The digital twin keeps continually learning the user's preferences allowing it to act as the user's proxy for the agent's permission requests. To emulate the learning phase, we propose a new usercentric dataset with examples following a multi-day transcript of user-agent interaction. Our evaluation shows that Pincer performs strongly on both security and utility in comparison to several baselines which includes variants of LLM judges and adaptations of Conseca (HotOS '25). We highlight attack types where Pincer's design leads to a significant security improvement compared to all other baselines, while outperforming the baselines even for other types of attacks.
title_cn: Pincer：基于数字孪生的智能体资源授权
abstract_cn: 编码智能体日益长时程、自主、依赖通用 shell，并维护自己的持久记忆以自我改进。这些能力让智能体强大，也让它们更难抵御外部对手。限制该架构的防御——类型化工具、信息流控制或策略预测引擎——为被采用而放弃太多功能。当今部署的智能体（如 Claude、Codex）依赖用户介入与自动模式沙箱的组合作为主要防御：用户维护的策略会随时间衰减，重复的权限请求导致用户疲劳，而自动模式的工具调用分类器不学习用户特定策略、也不以对抗场景为目标。Pincer 是一种在资源层运作、与工具调用层现有防御（如自动模式）协同的新防御。Pincer 的核心是数字孪生：一个在隔离上下文中运行、自动学习并执行动态用户特定最小权限策略的模型。数字孪生持续学习用户偏好，从而充当智能体权限请求的用户代理。为模拟学习阶段，我们提出一个遵循多日用户-智能体交互记录的新用户侧数据集。评估显示，Pincer 在安全性与效用两方面均强于多个基线（包括 LLM 裁判变体与 Conseca（HotOS '25）的改造），并在某些攻击类型上相对所有基线取得显著安全提升。
summary_cn: 提出资源层防御 Pincer：以隔离上下文的数字孪生持续学习用户最小权限策略并代理审批智能体请求，在自建多日交互数据集上对 LLM 裁判与 Conseca 改造基线同时改善安全与效用。
objective_summary: 提出 Pincer：用数字孪生模型自动学习并执行用户特定最小权限策略，代理处理智能体的权限请求，与工具调用层沙箱协同，并在自建用户交互数据集上与多类基线比较安全性与效用。
evidence_note: 构建多日用户-智能体交互数据集，与 LLM 裁判变体及 Conseca 改造等多基线在安全与效用两维对比，并分析 Pincer 优势显著的攻击类型；摘要未给出具体数值与显著性检验。
novelty_note: 以持续学习的数字孪生作为权限审批代理是智能体授权的新机制；与 Conseca 的上下文完整性路线同向，新意在资源层定位与用户特定动态策略。
scope: 结论适用于长时程编码智能体的资源授权场景与所测攻击类型；数字孪生的学习能力上限、多用户/团队共享环境等场景未覆盖。
limitations: 学习阶段需要多日交互数据，冷启动期策略不完整；孪生模型误判会直接放行或阻断真实操作；评估基于自建数据集，缺少在野部署与自适应攻击者实验。

title: Out of Sync, Out of Sight: Phantom State Attacks against IIoT Intrusion Detection
abstract: Machine learning-based intrusion detection systems (IDS) are critical for securing Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) environments. Most adversarial research against them perturbs the feature vector or the traffic that produces it, and depends on gradient access, repeated model queries, or a learned model of benign traffic. A smaller line of work reshapes packet timing without querying the detector, but makes malicious traffic mimic a learned model of benign timing. Across these approaches, one assumption of industrial monitoring pipelines has received little attention: temporal synchronization. An IDS reconstructs operational state by aggregating telemetry into sliding or tumbling windows, so its view depends not only on what is observed but on when each observation falls relative to a window boundary. We introduce the Phantom State Attack (PSA), which exploits that dependence under a passive, zero-query threat model. Rather than modifying packets, perturbing features, querying the classifier, or fitting any model of benign traffic, PSA injects bounded timing drift calibrated to the attack flow's own inter-arrival variability, moving observations across the nearest window boundary by the minimal shift needed. The IDS then reconstructs a phantom state that diverges from the true process state. We evaluate PSA on ToN-IoT and CIC IIoT 2025 (DataSense), against Random Forest, MLP and XGBoost, measuring detection degradation, synchronization distortion, stealth, and attacker cost. PSA degrades detection on flows carrying enough packets for window-boundary redistribution, and leaves others almost unchanged, so its effect is conditional. A query-based baseline reaches higher raw success but needs many queries per window, while PSA needs none. The results identify temporal aggregation as an attack surface reachable under weaker assumptions than prior evasion techniques.
title_cn: 失同步即失察：针对 IIoT 入侵检测的幻影状态攻击
abstract_cn: 基于机器学习的入侵检测系统（IDS）对保护工业物联网（IIoT）环境至关重要。针对它们的对抗研究大多扰动特征向量或产生特征的流量，依赖梯度访问、反复模型查询或对良性流量的建模。另一小支工作在不查询检测器的情况下重塑包定时，但需要让恶意流量模仿学习到的良性定时模型。在上述方法之外，工业监控流水线的一个假设很少受到关注：时间同步。IDS 通过把遥测聚合到滑动或翻滚窗口来重建运行状态，因此其视野不仅取决于观察到什么，还取决于每个观测落在相对窗口边界的哪个位置。我们提出幻影状态攻击（PSA），在被动、零查询威胁模型下利用这一依赖。PSA 不修改包、不扰动特征、不查询分类器、也不拟合任何良性流量模型，而是按攻击流自身的到达间隔变异校准有界定时漂移，把观测以所需最小位移推过最近的窗口边界。IDS 随即重建出与真实过程状态偏离的幻影状态。我们在 ToN-IoT 与 CIC IIoT 2025（DataSense）上、针对随机森林、MLP 与 XGBoost 评估 PSA，测量检测退化、同步失真、隐蔽性与攻击者成本。PSA 对携带足够包量、可发生窗口边界重分布的流造成检测退化，对其余流几乎无影响，因此其效果是条件性的。查询式基线达到更高的原始成功率，但每窗口需要大量查询，而 PSA 无需任何查询。结果把时间聚合标识为一个比既有规避技术假设更弱即可触达的攻击面。
summary_cn: 零查询被动攻击 PSA：借攻击流自身抖动校准定时漂移使观测移过 IDS 窗口边界，在 ToN-IoT 与 CIC IIoT 2025 上对 RF/MLP/XGBoost 造成条件性检测退化，无需模型查询或良性流量建模。
objective_summary: 提出利用窗口聚合时间依赖的幻影状态攻击：以有界定时漂移移动观测的窗口归属，使 IDS 重建偏离真实的状态；在两个 IIoT 数据集与三类模型上量化检测退化、隐蔽性与成本，并与查询式基线比较。
evidence_note: 在 ToN-IoT 与 CIC IIoT 2025 两个公开数据集上对随机森林、MLP、XGBoost 三类模型评估，测量检测退化、同步失真、隐蔽性与成本，并设查询式基线对照；为公开数据集实验，非真实产线部署。
novelty_note: 首次把 IDS 的时间同步/窗口聚合假设确立为攻击面：被动、零查询、无需良性流量模型或梯度，假设弱于已有特征扰动与定时模仿类规避技术。
scope: 结论适用于以滑动/翻滚窗口聚合遥测的 IDS 与所测数据集、模型；对包量过少的流效果有限（条件性），未在真实 IIoT 产线验证。
limitations: 效果依赖攻击流携带足够包量以发生窗口重分布；需能微调包定时（要求一定时钟控制）；在受控数据集上评估，未含检测器端时间源加固等防御对抗。

title: CITADEL: CWE-Guided Insertion of Hardware Trojans via Analysis of DFG-Enabled LLMs
abstract: The increasing sophistication of Hardware Trojans (HTs) and system-level vulnerabilities poses significant risks to modern integrated circuits. However, constructing realistic HT scenarios, remains a substantial burden: researchers must manually analyze complex RTL structures, identify plausible weaknesses, and craft stealthy, synthesizable insertions that preserve functional correctness. This paper introduces CITADEL CWE-Guided Insertion of Trojans via Analysis of DFG-Enabled LLMs, a framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) and Data Flow Graphs (DFGs) to automate CWE-grounded HT synthesis. CITADEL uses structured CWE semantics together with DFG-derived structural context to assist the user in identifying relevant vulnerabilities, localize the module surrounding the chosen insertion point, and perform intent-conditioned RTL modification. The framework produces minimal, synthesizable, and interface-preserving HTs with ultra-rare triggers. Experimental evaluation across diverse RTL designs demonstrates that all generated HTs are 100% syntactically correct, remain undetectable under large-scale random simulation, and are functionally triggerable under their intended activation conditions. These results highlight CITADEL as a scalable and principled method for generating realistic HT benchmarks.
title_cn: CITADEL：基于 DFG 增强 LLM 的 CWE 引导硬件木马注入
abstract_cn: 硬件木马（HT）与系统级漏洞日益复杂，给现代集成电路带来重大风险。然而构建真实的 HT 场景仍是沉重负担：研究人员必须手工分析复杂 RTL 结构、寻找可信弱点、并构造隐匿、可综合且保持功能正确的插入。本文提出 CITADEL（基于 DFG 增强 LLM 的 CWE 引导木马注入），一个利用大语言模型（LLM）与数据流图（DFG）自动化 CWE 锚定 HT 综合的框架。CITADEL 以结构化 CWE 语义与 DFG 衍生的结构上下文，协助用户识别相关漏洞、定位所选插入点周边模块，并执行意图条件的 RTL 修改。该框架产出最小、可综合、接口保持的 HT，并带超稀有触发器。在多样 RTL 设计上的实验评估表明，所有生成的 HT 100% 语法正确，在大规模随机仿真下不可检测，并能在预期激活条件下被功能性触发。这些结果凸显 CITADEL 是生成真实 HT 基准的可扩展且有原则的方法。
summary_cn: 提出 LLM+数据流图的 CWE 引导硬件木马自动生成框架 CITADEL：生成的木马 100% 语法正确、随机仿真下不可检测且可按触发条件激活，用于构建真实 HT 基准。
objective_summary: 提出 CITADEL 框架，结合 CWE 结构化语义与 DFG 结构上下文自动完成漏洞识别、插入点定位与意图条件 RTL 修改，生成最小可综合且带超稀有触发器的硬件木马基准。
evidence_note: 在多样 RTL 设计上评估：100% 语法正确、大规模随机仿真不可检测、预期条件可触发；未与已有 HT 生成方法或商用/学术 HT 检测工具对比。
novelty_note: 把 CWE 语义与 DFG 结构上下文接入 LLM 做 RTL 木马注入是已有组件的新组合；硬件木马自动生成方向已有工作，CWE 锚定与超稀有触发设计为新意。
scope: 结论适用于所测 RTL 设计与 LLM 配置下的基准生成场景；对先进工艺物理级木马与形式化检测工具的对抗未评估。
limitations: 评估以随机仿真为主，未对抗形式化或机器学习 HT 检测器；生成质量依赖所选 CWE 库覆盖；框架的双用途风险需依赖使用规范约束。

title: SideKernel: A Usable microVM Sandbox for AI Coding Agents on macOS
abstract: AI coding agents are untrusted system components, yet they require autonomy on the developer machines they run on. This contradiction is a security problem. Sandboxes provide an isolated environment, but for local macOS development, the existing local, open-source options for AI coding agents are few in number and cumbersome to use. I conducted a formative online user survey which indicates that fewer than 40% of AI coding agent users run their agents in a sandbox and identifies the top usability barriers hindering AI coding agent sandbox adoption. These findings are used to develop SideKernel: an open-source, local, microVM-based macOS sandbox for AI coding agents designed for usability. To evaluate SideKernel, I compiled a list of sandboxes available on the market and filtered it against five inclusion criteria. Then I performed a comparative analysis between SideKernel and the sandboxes that satisfy these criteria, across 23 capability tests derived from the usability barriers revealed by the user survey. I discovered that only a few sandboxes are similar to SideKernel, and that among those, Docker Sandboxes and SideKernel score highest on capability features related to usability. A secondary contribution of this paper is a survey of the existing solution space for local, open-source, microVM-based macOS sandboxes for AI coding agents.
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Georgia Tech M.S. Cybersecurity practicum project
title_cn: SideKernel：macOS 上面向 AI 编码智能体的可用 microVM 沙箱
abstract_cn: AI 编码智能体是不受信任的系统组件，却需要在开发者的机器上获得自主权。这一矛盾构成安全问题。沙箱提供隔离环境，但对本地 macOS 开发而言，面向 AI 编码智能体的本地开源选择数量少且使用繁琐。我开展了一项形成性在线用户调查，显示少于 40% 的 AI 编码智能体用户在沙箱中运行智能体，并识别出阻碍沙箱采用的主要可用性障碍。基于这些发现，我开发了 SideKernel：一个面向可用性设计的开源、本地、基于 microVM 的 macOS 智能体沙箱。为评估 SideKernel，我汇编了市场上的沙箱清单并按五条纳入标准过滤，然后围绕调查揭示的可用性障碍派生的 23 项能力测试，对 SideKernel 与满足标准的沙箱做对比分析。我发现只有少数沙箱与 SideKernel 相似，其中 Docker Sandboxes 与 SideKernel 在可用性相关能力上得分最高。本文的另一贡献是对本地开源 microVM macOS 智能体沙箱现有方案空间的综述。
summary_cn: 用户调查显示不到 40% 的 AI 编码智能体用户使用沙箱；据此开发的 macOS microVM 沙箱 SideKernel 在 23 项可用性能力测试中与 Docker Sandboxes 并列最高分，并综述了该方案空间。
objective_summary: 通过用户调查识别 AI 编码智能体沙箱的采用障碍，构建开源 microVM macOS 沙箱 SideKernel，并按 23 项能力测试与市面沙箱做对比分析。
evidence_note: 形成性用户调查（样本量未在摘要给出）+市面沙箱按五条纳入标准过滤后的 23 项能力对比测试；为能力/可用性评估，未做对抗性逃逸实验。
novelty_note: microVM 沙箱是成熟技术，新意在于面向智能体场景的可用性工程与 macOS 本地方案空间的系统梳理。
scope: 结论适用于 macOS 本地开发场景与所测沙箱清单；能力测试基于功能可用性，不构成安全强度证明；Linux/Windows 未覆盖。
limitations: 单一作者的硕士实践项目，调查样本有限；评估为能力对比而非攻击面/逃逸测试；与 Docker Sandboxes 的差距分析粒度较粗。

title: SoK: Stablecoins in the Quantum Era
abstract: Stablecoins support payments, trading, collateral, and cross-chain settlement across the digital-asset ecosystem. They also concentrate value behind issuer, custody, upgrade, oracle, and bridge keys while inheriting the quantum vulnerabilities of host-chain accounts, consensus, rollups, and privacy systems. This paper presents a Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) on post-quantum stablecoins. We develop a stablecoin-specific threat model, map cryptographic dependencies to monetary control surfaces, and classify migration choices along three dimensions: who can authorize a change, where the change must occur, and whether it is hybrid, post-quantum native, or an encapsulation of a classical component. We emphasize an authority-liability gap: the party able to migrate a component is often different from the holders, exchanges, protocols, or issuers that bear the loss if it fails. We review the relevant cryptographic primitives, but distinguish general blockchain failures from their stablecoin-specific effects. We also examine recent blockchain and issuer-controlled interoperability proposals, and relate migration choices to redemption, continuity, and intervention requirements under current stablecoin regulation. Our findings identify open problems in aggregate and threshold authorization, operation-specific security levels and costs, dormant and wrapped supply, private and compliance-enabled transfers, and measurement of quantum-vulnerable stablecoin exposure.
title_cn: SoK：量子时代的稳定币
abstract_cn: 稳定币支撑数字资产生态中的支付、交易、抵押与跨链结算。它们同时把价值集中在发行方、托管、升级、预言机与桥接密钥之后，并继承宿主链账户、共识、rollup 与隐私系统的量子脆弱性。本文是关于后量子稳定币的知识系统化（SoK）。我们建立稳定币专属威胁模型，把密码学依赖映射到货币控制面，并沿三个维度分类迁移选择：谁可以授权变更、变更必须发生在哪里、以及它是混合式、后量子原生还是对经典组件的封装。我们强调权责缺口：能够迁移某组件的一方往往不是在该组件失效时承担损失的持有者、交易所、协议或发行方。我们回顾相关密码学原语，但把一般区块链失效与其稳定币特有效应区分开。我们还考察近期由区块链与发行方控制的互操作性提案，并把迁移选择与现行稳定币监管下的赎回、连续性与干预要求联系起来。我们发现的开放问题包括：聚合与门限授权、面向操作的量子安全等级与成本、休眠与封装供应、私有与合规转账，以及量子脆弱稳定币敞口的度量。
summary_cn: 系统化稳定币的后量子迁移：建立专属威胁模型与三维度迁移分类，指出迁移权与损失承担方分离的权责缺口，并列出门限授权、休眠供应、合规转账等开放问题。
objective_summary: 以 SoK 形式系统化稳定币面对量子威胁的密码学依赖与迁移选择，建立威胁模型与分类框架，并把技术选择与稳定币监管要求相关联。
evidence_note: SoK 属系统化综述：覆盖发行、托管、升级、预言机、桥接等控制面，区分一般区块链失效与稳定币特有效应，并关联现行监管；无新实验证据。
novelty_note: 稳定币专属的后量子威胁模型与权责缺口（能迁移者≠承担损失者）是新的系统化视角；单点技术均为已有密码学组件的组合。
scope: 结论适用于公链稳定币及其密钥治理与迁移规划；对中心化发行方的链下风控细节与非公链形式数字货币未覆盖。
limitations: 迁移成本与操作安全等级多为定性分析；各区块链实际后量子部署进度变化快，结论时效受限；未给出可执行的迁移路线图评估。

title: Evaluating and Improving the Robustness of Large Language Models to Input Sequence Variations
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) in production systems face prompt injections, trojans (backdoors), and manipulation of automatic quality metrics. This thesis develops models, methods, and algorithms for evaluating and improving LLM robustness to adversarial input sequence variations. We propose R_stab(f), a generative robustness metric based on the Jensen-Shannon divergence between per-step output distributions under small input perturbations. For localized attacks we prove V(h) <= 1 - R_class(h), where R_class(h) is the probability that a decision operator h keeps its decision under small perturbations. For non-localized attacks we propose a calibrated empirical model. For LLM-as-a-Judge systems we develop ASA, an adaptive evolutionary black-box attack that reaches an attack success rate (ASR) of up to 73.8%, with transfer between open models up to 62.6%. On Trojan Detection Challenge 2023 data (Pythia-1.4B), surrogate triggers reach REASR ~0.99 while recall of the true triggers is ~0.17 against a baseline of ~0.14. On SaTML CTF 2024 we systematize four classes of bypasses of multi-layer defenses, which reduce the ASR from 90% to 15-25%. Committees of 5-7 heterogeneous models reduce the ASR for Gemma-3-4B by 47-55 percentage points, to 19.3% with 7 models. For agentic systems based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), we propose AttestMCP, which attests tool calls with HMAC-protected packets at under 0.1 ms per call, and the Commit Boundary isolation pattern. On the MCPBench benchmark of 847 scenarios they reduce the average ASR from 53.7% to 12.4%. The methods are implemented in the JudgeGuard and TrojanArmor software suites and the MCPSec module.
comment: PhD thesis, 2026. 118 pages
title_cn: 评估与提升大语言模型对输入序列变化的鲁棒性
abstract_cn: 生产系统中的大语言模型（LLM）面临提示注入、木马（后门）与自动质量指标被操纵等威胁。本博士论文开发用于评估与改进 LLM 对对抗性输入序列变化鲁棒性的模型、方法与算法。我们提出基于小扰动下逐步输出分布 Jensen-Shannon 散度的生成式鲁棒性度量 R_stab(f)。对局部化攻击我们证明 V(h) ≤ 1 − R_class(h)，其中 R_class(h) 是决策算子 h 在小扰动下保持决策的概率；对非局部化攻击提出校准的经验模型。对 LLM-as-a-Judge 系统，我们开发自适应进化黑盒攻击 ASA，攻击成功率（ASR）最高达 73.8%，在开源模型间迁移至 62.6%。在木马检测挑战赛 2023 数据（Pythia-1.4B）上，代理触发器 REASR 约 0.99，而真实触发器召回约 0.17（基线约 0.14）。在 SaTML CTF 2024 上我们系统化四类多层防御绕过，把 ASR 从 90% 降到 15–25%。5–7 个异构模型组成的委员会把 Gemma-3-4B 的 ASR 降低 47–55 个百分点，7 模型时降至 19.3%。对基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的智能体系统，我们提出以 HMAC 保护包对工具调用认证的 AttestMCP（每次调用低于 0.1 ms）与 Commit Boundary 隔离模式；在 847 个场景的 MCPBench 上把平均 ASR 从 53.7% 降到 12.4%。方法实现于 JudgeGuard、TrojanArmor 软件套件与 MCPSec 模块。
summary_cn: 博士论文合集：提出鲁棒性度量 R_stab、ASA 攻击（ASR 至 73.8%）与 MCP 工具调用认证 AttestMCP，847 场景上平均 ASR 从 53.7% 降至 12.4%。
objective_summary: 系统研究 LLM 对输入序列变化的鲁棒性：提出鲁棒性度量与理论界、ASA 进化攻击、木马触发器代理分析、CTF 防御绕过分类、模型委员会防御，以及 MCP 工具调用认证方案 AttestMCP 与隔离模式。
evidence_note: 覆盖 TDC 2023、SaTML CTF 2024、MCPBench（847 场景）等多个公开基准并给出具体 ASR/REASR 数字；论文为博士论文合集，各部分评估深度不一、无统一统计检验。
novelty_note: 单一论文内贯通度量、攻击、防御与系统化（四类 CTF 绕过），AttestMCP 与 Commit Boundary 隔离是面向 MCP 的新组合；单项多为已有技术的改进与集成。
scope: 结论适用于所测模型（Pythia-1.4B、Gemma-3-4B 等）与基准（TDC 2023、SaTML CTF 2024、MCPBench）；对更大规模前沿模型与生产部署的适用性未验证。
limitations: 论文合集性质，各方法之间缺乏统一威胁模型；部分实验在较小模型上进行；AttestMCP 的 HMAC 密钥管理与部署成本未充分讨论。

title: Mitigating Private Data Leakage in LLMs with Whiteout
abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) are trained on massive, largely unfiltered datasets, including content scraped from nearly every accessible website and user inputs. As a result, LLMs often memorize and reproduce personally sensitive information (PSI) such as birth dates, phone numbers, and home addresses. This leads to significant privacy risks, particularly for high-profile individuals such as executives, politicians, and judges. Existing mitigations largely rely on machine unlearning. However, these methods often remove more information than needed, degrade model utility and safety, and are highly vulnerable to attacks. This paper presents Whiteout, a practical tool that, upon requests by individuals, prevents LLMs from regurgitating their genuine PSIs, by overwriting them using precise and carefully designed obfuscation samples. We evaluate Whiteout on modern LLMs of varying sizes and makers, including a widely-used OpenAI model. Results show that Whiteout effectively prevents disclosure of the targeted PSIs, has negligible impact on model utility and safety, and outperforms existing alternatives. We also test Whiteout against a wide range of countermeasures, from black-box attacks like jailbreaking to white-box adaptive attacks like relearning and quantization. Finally, we conclude with a discussion on the security and ethical implications of Whiteout.
title_cn: 用 Whiteout 缓解 LLM 中的私人数据泄露
abstract_cn: 现代大语言模型（LLM）在大量未经滤除的数据上训练，包括从几乎所有可访问网站抓取的内容和用户输入。因此 LLM 常会记忆并复现生日、电话号码、家庭住址等个人敏感信息（PSI），带来显著隐私风险，对高管、政客、法官等公众人物尤甚。现有缓解手段主要依赖机器遗忘，但这些方法往往移除超过必要的信息、损害模型效用与安全性，且极易受攻击。本文提出 Whiteout，一个实用工具：在个人提出请求时，通过精确且精心设计的混淆样本覆写其真实 PSI，阻止 LLM 复述。我们在不同规模与厂商的现代 LLM（包括一个广泛使用的 OpenAI 模型）上评估 Whiteout。结果显示 Whiteout 有效阻止目标 PSI 的披露，对模型效用与安全性影响可忽略，并优于现有替代方案。我们还在从越狱等黑盒攻击到再学习、量化等白盒自适应攻击的广泛对抗手段下测试 Whiteout。最后讨论 Whiteout 的安全与伦理影响。
summary_cn: 提出 Whiteout：以精心设计的混淆样本覆写个人敏感信息阻止 LLM 复述，对多规模模型（含 OpenAI 模型）有效且效用影响可忽略，可抵御再学习、量化等白盒自适应攻击。
objective_summary: 提出以定向混淆覆写替代遗忘的 PSI 抑制工具 Whiteout，在多厂商多规模模型上评估披露阻止效果、效用/安全影响，并在黑盒到白盒自适应攻击下测试鲁棒性。
evidence_note: 在多个厂商与规模的现代模型（含广泛使用的 OpenAI 模型）上评估，对抗测试覆盖黑盒越狱到白盒再学习、量化等自适应手段，并报告效用与安全影响可忽略；具体数字未在摘要给出。
novelty_note: 以定向混淆覆写替代移除式遗忘的思路相对新颖，绕开了遗忘方法过度删除与可逆性弱点；与模型编辑/投毒一线工作相关但目标（PSI 抑制）与威胁模型不同。
scope: 结论适用于个体请求删除自身 PSI 的场景与所测模型；对非公众人物的大规模 PSI 清除、多语言内容与持续预训练后的持久性未系统覆盖。
limitations: 覆写依赖能定位并修改模型权重；混淆样本若被识破可能诱导错误输出而非沉默；摘要未给出定量对比数字与长期再学习抵抗力。

title: Unifying Privacy Accounting: Information Equivalence and Information Loss
abstract: Differential privacy (DP) admits several notions, but the choice among them may affect both privacy analysis and utility. In this paper, we consider four mainstream curve-based privacy notions within a unified information-theoretic framework. For a fixed ordered pair of output distributions, we establish information equivalence among the two directional privacy profiles of $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-DP, the pair of hypothesis-testing trade-off functions, and the extended privacy-loss distribution. The exact R\'enyi differential privacy (RDP) curve joins this equivalence class whenever it is finite at some order greater than one. Under this mild condition, choosing among these notions changes only their semantic interpretation and computational requirements. In contrast, taking the maximum of the directional privacy profiles or compressing the RDP curve into a single zero-concentrated differential privacy (zCDP) parameter can lose information. We quantify the information loss between the exact RDP curve and its zCDP bound for standard noise mechanisms. This gap is zero for Gaussian noise but generally positive for Gaussian-mixture, Laplace, discrete Gaussian, and Poisson-subsampled Gaussian mechanisms. Moreover, this gap grows linearly with the number of independently composed mechanisms. Our information-theoretic perspective has practical consequences. At the same certified privacy level, retaining the full RDP curve rather than using zCDP reduces the required noise variance by up to $45\%$ for Gaussian-mixture noise in workloads comparable in size to the American Community Survey. For DP-SGD on Fashion-MNIST under Poisson subsampling, an RDP-based privacy accountant improves test accuracy by up to $8.73$ percentage points compared to a zCDP-based accountant when both are calibrated to the same $(\varepsilon,\delta)$ guarantee.
title_cn: 统一隐私核算：信息等价与信息损失
abstract_cn: 差分隐私（DP）有多种定义，选择不同定义可能同时影响隐私分析与效用。本文在统一的信息论框架下考察四种主流的曲线型隐私定义。对固定的有序输出分布对，我们建立 (ε,δ)-DP 的两个方向性隐私曲线、假设检验权衡函数对、以及扩展隐私损失分布之间的信息等价。当精确 Rényi 差分隐私（RDP）曲线在某个大于 1 的阶上有限时，精确 RDP 曲线也加入该等价类。在此温和条件下，在这些定义之间选择只改变语义解释与计算代价。相反，取方向性隐私曲线的最大值或把 RDP 曲线压缩成单个零集中差分隐私（zCDP）参数会损失信息。我们量化了标准噪声机制下精确 RDP 曲线与其 zCDP 界之间的信息损失：该差距对高斯噪声为零，但对高斯混合、拉普拉斯、离散高斯与泊松子采样高斯机制一般为正，且随独立复合机制数线性增长。我们的信息论视角有实际后果：在同一认证隐私水平下，保留完整 RDP 曲线而非使用 zCDP，在与美国社区调查（ACS）规模相当的工作负载中，对高斯混合噪声最多可减少 45% 的所需噪声方差；对泊松子采样下的 Fashion-MNIST DP-SGD，同样校准到 (ε,δ) 保证时，基于 RDP 的隐私核算器比基于 zCDP 的核算器最多提升 8.73 个百分点测试精度。
summary_cn: 信息论框架下证明四类曲线型 DP 定义信息等价，量化 RDP→zCDP 压缩的信息损失（高斯为零、随复合线性增长）：保留完整 RDP 最多省 45% 噪声方差、DP-SGD 精度最多 +8.73 pp。
objective_summary: 建立统一信息论框架，刻画 (ε,δ)-DP、权衡函数、扩展 PLD 与 RDP 曲线间的信息等价条件，量化 RDP→zCDP 压缩的信息损失及其对噪声量与 DP-SGD 精度的影响。
evidence_note: 等价性与信息损失均有完整证明，并对高斯、高斯混合、拉普拉斯、离散高斯、泊松子采样高斯等标准机制给出量化；以 ACS 规模工作负载与 Fashion-MNIST DP-SGD 实验佐证数值收益。
novelty_note: 方向性隐私曲线与权衡函数的对偶已知，新意在于把精确 RDP 曲线纳入等价类的条件、RDP→zCDP 信息损失的刻画及其随复合线性增长的结论。
scope: 结论适用于曲线型隐私定义与标准噪声机制的核算比较；对非曲线型隐私概念及自适应复合之外的复合场景未覆盖。
limitations: 等价类要求 RDP 曲线在某大于 1 的阶上有限；信息损失的具体数值依赖机制族；端到端收益在所测工作负载上展示，未覆盖全部 DP 部署形态。

title: Hop-Decayed Influence: New Vulnerabilities of Structural Auxiliary Indexing in GraphRAG Pipelines with LLM
abstract: GraphRAG pipelines construct auxiliary structures during offline indexing--semantic summaries, hierarchical edges, and pre-computed scores--that determine how retrieval is prioritised at query time. Prior attacks target only instance-level components (nodes, edges, triples), overlooking these schema-level structures. We formalise Auxiliary Schema-Level Entity as a novel attack surface and propose the 3S Framework (Semantics, Structure, Scoring) for its systematic exploitation. Our Hop-Decayed Influence (HDI) attack identifies high-impact targets through query-aware influence propagation and corrupts their auxiliary structures post-indexing. Across two benchmarks (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA) and two architectures (Microsoft GraphRAG, HippoRAG2), HDI achieves 88-94% attack success rate while modifying as few as 0.016% of auxiliary structures. Each modification affects up to 6.00 queries (Schema Leverage Ratio), demonstrating 1:N amplification unavailable to instance-level attacks. Manipulated structures evade perplexity and paraphrase defenses with over 99% evasion rate, as they remain linguistically coherent system-generated artifacts. These results reveal that auxiliary schema-level entities receive implicit trust without runtime validation, constituting a structural blind spot in current GraphRAG defenses. https://github.com/Jisung-Pacific/HDI-GraphRAG-Attack.
comment: 14 pages. Published in IFIP SEC 2026. Best Paper Award
title_cn: 跳数衰减影响：LLM GraphRAG 流水线中结构化辅助索引的新脆弱性
abstract_cn: GraphRAG 流水线在离线索引期间构建辅助结构——语义摘要、层级边、预计算分数——它们决定查询时检索的优先级。已有攻击只针对实例级组件（节点、边、三元组），忽视这些模式级（schema 级）结构。我们把辅助模式级实体形式化为一个新的攻击面，并提出 3S 框架（语义、结构、评分）对其进行系统利用。我们的跳数衰减影响（HDI）攻击通过查询感知的影响传播识别高影响目标，并在索引后破坏其辅助结构。在两个基准（HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA）与两种架构（Microsoft GraphRAG、HippoRAG2）上，HDI 仅修改 0.016% 的辅助结构即达到 88–94% 的攻击成功率；每次修改最多影响 6.00 个查询（模式杠杆率），展现出实例级攻击不具备的 1:N 放大。被操纵的结构对困惑度与改写防御保持 99% 以上的规避率，因为它们仍是语言连贯的系统生成工件。这些结果表明辅助模式级实体在无运行时验证的情况下获得隐式信任，构成当前 GraphRAG 防御的结构性盲区。代码见 https://github.com/Jisung-Pacific/HDI-GraphRAG-Attack。
summary_cn: 把 GraphRAG 模式级辅助结构确立为新攻击面：HDI 改动 0.016% 结构即在两基准两架构达 88–94% 成功率，单次修改最多影响 6 个查询，防御规避率超 99%。
objective_summary: 提出辅助模式级实体这一新攻击面与 3S 利用框架，HDI 攻击经查询感知影响传播定位高影响目标并在索引后注入损坏，在两基准两架构上量化成功率、放大比与防御规避。
evidence_note: HotpotQA 与 2WikiMultiHopQA 两基准、Microsoft GraphRAG 与 HippoRAG2 两架构的系统评估，报告成功率区间、模式杠杆率与对两类防御的规避率；IFIP SEC 2026 录用并获最佳论文；代码开源。
novelty_note: 首次把离线索引生成的模式级辅助结构确立为攻击面，指出其隐式信任盲区与 1:N 放大能力，区别于已有实例级（节点/边/三元组）投毒。
scope: 结论适用于采用离线辅助索引结构的 GraphRAG 流水线（所测两种架构）；对运行时验证辅助结构的部署或无辅助索引的朴素 RAG 未覆盖。
limitations: 攻击假设攻击者可在索引后修改辅助结构（需写入权限）；仅在两个 QA 基准与两种架构上验证；对运行时完整性校验类防御未评估。

title: MIRROR: Multipath Quorum Integrity for LLM Multi-Agent Communication
abstract: Inter-agent communication is central to Large Language Model Multi-Agent Systems (LLM-MAS), but it introduces an underexplored vulnerability: Agent-in-the-Middle (AiTM) attacks that manipulate messages in transit without compromising the agents themselves. Prior work reports Attack Success Rates (ASR) approaching 100% on structured tasks. Existing defenses rely on semantic validation, which requires additional inference and can block benign outputs, or on transport-layer encryption, which does not help when an intermediary legitimately terminates TLS. We present MIRROR, a communication-layer integrity primitive that replicates a single canonicalized payload across k logical routes and accepts a message only when a strict majority of routes report the same digest. MIRROR uses unkeyed hashing and so authenticates nothing on its own, since an active on-path adversary can always recompute a digest over a payload it has modified. All integrity derives from the assumption that honest routes form a majority. The digest serves only to make witness routes constant-size and to bind the recovered payload to the quorum-agreed value under second-preimage resistance. We give the guarantee under a route-compromise bound alpha < 0.5, and extend it to correlated routes, where the quantity that matters is the size of the largest shared-failure group and not the route count. We further show that availability and integrity degrade at the same threshold: below alpha = 0.5, quorum-denial and message-dropping adversaries cannot block honest traffic. Across MMLU, HumanEval, and MBPP on two frameworks and four communication topologies, and in a MetaGPT deployment against a production API, MIRROR reduces ASR to 0% below the threshold at 1x LLM token cost. LLM-as-a-Judge costs 35x in the same deployment, and blocks up to 44.2% of benign outputs in the topology sweep.
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundations of Language Model Security (FLMSec). 12 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables
title_cn: MIRROR：面向 LLM 多智能体通信的多路径仲裁完整性
